article.articleHeadline: Bird flu outbreak in Bengaluru contained with no human infections reported
article.articleSummary: As of 25 April 2026, Bengaluru’s avian influenza outbreak has been contained with no human infections. The H5N1 outbreak was detected on 14 April at a government poultry training facility in Hesaraghatta, Bengaluru, and laboratory-confirmed in Bhopal. A three-kilometre infected zone and a 10-kilometre surveillance zone were established; all birds at the facility were culled, and eggs and contaminated feed disposed of per biosecurity protocols. Over 10 days, health teams screened more than 28,000 residents across 22 villages within the surveillance area, with repeated rounds of screening and sanitation. Samples from quarantined staff taken mid-monitoring were negative, and additional samples were sent for analysis. No human infections have been reported in the affected facility or surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルールの鳥インフルエンザ outbreak が封じ込められ、人的感染報告なし
triage.triage_reason: H5N1 avian influenza の確認事例ですが、現在のところ人間感染は報告されておらず、アウトブレイクは封じ込められている。動物感染のシグナルとして記録する価値があるため経過観察を推奨。
triage.notes: H5N1 ウイルスの確認されたケースですが、人間感染は報告されておらず、大規模な疫学的対応（2万8千人以上のスクリーニング）が実施され、アウトブレイクは封じ込められている。動物起源の感染症イベントとして記録は必要だが、現在のところ国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態の閾値には達していない。ただし H5N1 の人間感染可能性により継続的な監視は重要。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes tekankan batas waktu 4 jam cegah cemaran bakteri dapur gizi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health emphasizes a four-hour deadline to prevent bacterial contamination in the nutrition kitchen.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 April 2026, Indonesia's Ministry of Health enforces a four-hour maximum from cooking to distribution to prevent bacterial growth and food poisoning in the national nutrition fulfillment program. Dr. Then Suyanti, Director of Environmental Health, Jakarta, noted the contamination risk chain starts at raw material storage and ends with final distribution to consumers. Dishes should be cooked thoroughly and portioned for large volumes; distribution vehicles must be clean and dedicated to food to avoid cross-contamination. Water used in kitchens has high Escherichia coli findings; although the National Nutrition Agency (BGN) recommends water treatment, outputs must be tested regularly. A two-layer surveillance system—internal by kitchen operators and external by Puskesmas via Environmental Health Inspections (IKL) and spot sampling—exists, with a Fast Action Team ready to investigate suspected outbreaks and inform improvements for SPPG (Nutrition Service Provision Units).

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、栄養厨房の細菌汚染防止のため4時間の期限を強調
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は食品安全対策に関する行政的ガイダンスの発表であり、新たな感染症アウトブレイク事例や異常な感染症発生の報告ではない。既知のリスク管理の標準化を扱っており、IHR基準やWPROスクリーニング基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア保健省による食品衛生管理の予防的ガイダンス発表。大腸菌（E. coli）の汚染リスク低減を目的とした行政措置だが、実際のアウトブレイク事例や患者発生の報告ではない。シグナル検知対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Bùng phát bệnh tay chân miệng, cảnh giác với những biến chứng nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of hand, foot and mouth disease; beware of dangerous complications.
article.articleSummary: HFMD outbreaks surge across Vietnam, with Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City reporting rising pediatric admissions. Nationwide HFMD cases reach about 26,000 with 8 deaths since January, and March saw a spike in weekly cases. The resurgence of Enterovirus 71 (EV71), especially the highly virulent C1 variant, is driving severe neurological and cardiovascular complications and rapid progression, increasing intensive care needs across the south. In Hanoi, major pediatric centers (Bach Mai Hospital, Xanh Pon Hospital) report daily HFMD presentations and family clusters; in Ho Chi Minh City, overloaded hospitals and expanded bed capacity accompany an uptick in severe cases. A 12-month-old at 108 Military Medical Hospital was monitored for a high-risk HFMD progression and stabilized after treatment. Authorities emphasize early recognition and infection control; EV71 vaccines for children 2 months to under 6 years are expected to arrive soon.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の流行、危険な合併症に警戒が必要
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム国内での手足口病（Enterovirus 71）の大規模流行で、8月からの累計約26,000例、8死亡、特に神経学的・心血管系の重篤な合併症を伴う高病原性C1株の再出現。2つ以上のIHR基準に該当し、国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事は明示的にハノイとホーチミンシティでの流行を報告。全国で約26,000例、8死亡。高病原性EV71 C1株による神経学的・心血管系合併症の増加。ワクチン到着予定と当局が言及。WPROスクリーニング基準の全5項目に該当し、フルRRA進行を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: New Initiative: Haryana Intensifies Fight against Malaria with Targeted Micro Plans and Community Outreach
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day 2026, Haryana launches intensified malaria elimination with village and mohalla micro-surveillance, source tracing, and high-risk group monitoring. A micro plan covers areas with malaria in the previous year; door-to-door surveys exceed 950 visits. Every reported case now undergoes mandatory investigation by a team including an epidemiologist to identify origin and curb transmission. With migratory labourers driving most new infections, monthly labour-site inspections are on the first Monday. The burden declined from 4,485 cases in 2014 to 2025's 202, with no deaths; 515 cases were recorded in 2025 (202 in-state, 313 linked to other states). By March 31, 2026 only 8 cases; tests exceed 3 million in 2025, ABER 12.37%, positivity 0.014%. RDTs will be used in field surveys; microscopy remains the main diagnosis at institutes. Citizens urged to report fever and complete treatment; private practitioners to notify under Epidemic Diseases Act, 1899.

triage.headline_ja: 新イニシアティブ：ハリヤナ州がターゲット化されたマイクロプランとコミュニティアウトリーチによるマラリア対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: マラリア感染者数は大幅に減少し（2014年の4,485例から2025年の202例），死亡例はなく，公衆衛生への深刻な影響はない。予防措置の強化が主体であり、国際的拡大リスクもない。
triage.notes: ハリヤナ州はインドに位置する。記事はWorld Malaria Day 2026に際してのマラリア対策強化についての報道で、感染者数が継続的に減少していることが主要なポイント。2026年3月31日時点で8例のみという低い発生数であり、緊急対応を要するシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Bohol steps up campaign vs rabies, reviews ordinance
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention in Bohol intensified as the Provincial Rabies Council revises the Bohol Rabies Prevention and Eradication Program (Ordinance No. 2007-012; amended 2010-001). Board Member Mutya Kismit Tirol led a meeting with stakeholders to update provisions addressing vaccination, animal registration, movement, and penalties. Health officials reported a surge in animal bite incidents, with 10,288 human bite cases in Q1 2026, predominantly from cats. To bolster response, Bohol is expanding its Animal Bite Treatment Centers from 28 to include new facilities at President Carlos P. Garcia Memorial Hospital, Rural Health Unit San Miguel, and Rural Health Unit Pilar. All recommendations were integrated into the proposed measure, which passed first reading, with Tirol optimistic approval by May 2026. The effort emphasizes multi-sectoral collaboration and stricter enforcement to curb rabies across the province.

triage.headline_ja: ボホール州が狂犬病対策キャンペーンを強化、条例を見直し
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は重要な公衆衛生上の課題であり、動物咬傷事例の急増（Q1 2026で10,288件）が報告されているが、現段階では地域内の予防・管理強化であり国際的拡大リスクや深刻な患者死亡の明記がないため。情報充実を待ち、今後の患者発生状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 動物咬傷事例の急増（10,288件/Q1 2026）が報告されており、狂犬病は潜在的に深刻だが、記事では患者の重症度や死亡率の具体的な記載がない。ボホール州での地域的な予防・管理措置強化の段階であり、国際的なリスク評価には追加情報が必要。続報を注視してください。

article.articleHeadline: विश्व मलेरिया दिवस पर जागरूकता अभियान, रोकथाम व उन्मूलन पर जोर - Prabhat Khabar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Malaria Day: Emphasis on an awareness campaign, prevention and eradication
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day events were held in Mohania town across all block-level Additional Primary Health Centers and Health Sub-Centers to raise malaria awareness and promote prevention and eradication. Health workers told residents that malaria is a serious but entirely preventable disease, and timely testing and treatment can control it. Preventive measures highlighted include use of mosquito nets, maintaining cleanliness, eliminating standing water, and keeping surrounding environments clean. Programs were conducted at facilities in Muthani, Mudharia, Tekari Kala, Piparia, and other centers. The campaign carried the theme Drive to End Malaria, Now We Can, Now We Must, urging collective action to eradicate malaria. Dr. Vijay Kumar, Hospital Superintendent, noted ongoing government malaria-elimination campaigns and urged the public to seek prompt testing for fever and avoid negligence.

triage.headline_ja: 世界マラリアデー：認識向上キャンペーン、予防と根絶に力点
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は世界マラリアデーの啓発キャンペーンイベント報道であり、新たなマラリア流行の報告や異常な増加を示すものではない。公衆衛生上の新規脅威を示唆する情報がなく、予防啓発活動の実施報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界マラリアデー（4月25日）に関連した定期的な啓発キャンペーン報道。ビハール州モハニア地域で予防・根絶に焦点を当てた公衆衛生キャンペーンが実施されたという内容で、新規の流行事象や異常な疾患増加を報告するものではない。シグナル検出の対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: 69 Siswa di Kediri Keracunan Makanan MBG, Ditemukan Bakteri E. coli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 69 students in Kediri suffer MBG food poisoning, E. coli bacteria found
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli (E. coli) contamination linked to Kediri's Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program in Indonesia, affecting 69 elementary students from SDN Ketami 1, SDN Ketami 2, and SDN Tempurejo 1 in Pesantren District. After MBG meals on 22 April, pupils experienced nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and fever; the incident was reported on 24 April and published on 25 April 2026. Laboratory tests confirmed E. coli in the meals, indicating the food was unfit for consumption. Kediri City Government’s Bappeda head Ferry Djatmiko stated authorities promptly observed at the Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi (SPPG) Tempurejo. No student required inpatient care, and all are improving. The MBG task force, in coordination with Badan Gizi Nasional, is conducting a thorough evaluation. Preliminary findings point to violations of standard operating procedures in food preparation, with ongoing investigations.

triage.headline_ja: ケディリで69人の学生が食中毒MBG、E. coli菌が検出
triage.triage_reason: 限定的な地域食中毒イベント（69名、入院者なし）であり、IHR基準の重大性・国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし食品安全衛生の管理可能性に疑問があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 限定的な学校給食での食中毒事例。患者69名は全員外来治療で、入院患者なし。当局による調査と食品安全手順の改善が進行中。国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: AI giúp phát hiện, cảnh báo sớm các ổ dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AI helps detect and provide early warnings of outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: AI and big data are highlighted at ICCM 2026 (April 20–25, Ho Chi Minh City) as a shift from passive outbreak detection to proactive early warnings and real-time antimicrobial stewardship. More than 1,000 healthcare professionals from 15 countries discussed using AI to issue early outbreak alerts, track transmission via genomic sequencing, and optimize antibiotic use in real time. Deputy Minister of Health Nguyen Trong Khoa identified healthcare-associated infections and antimicrobial resistance as major challenges, outlining Vietnam’s National Action Plan on Infection Control 2025–2030, expansion of electronic medical records, and digital transformation, with a push to link microbiology data to EMRs and progressively deploy AI for detection and resistance forecasting. Ngô Quốc Đạt, Rector of Ho Chi Minh City University of Medicine and Pharmacy, stressed the need for innovation in infection control and clinical microbiology amid rising emerging infectious diseases and resistance. The conference underscores academia–hospital collaboration to translate AI and molecular diagnostics into practice.

triage.headline_ja: AI が感染症の早期発見と警告に役立つ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症の具体的な発生イベントではなく、AIと大数据を活用した感染症検知システムの国際会議（ICCM 2026）についての報告である。実際の患者発生や具体的な疾患アウトブレイクの報告がなく、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症のシグナルではなく、感染症対策・AI活用についての国際会議の報告である。疾患名が『Unknown Illness』とされているが、実際のアウトブレイクイベントの報告ではなく、会議での抽象的な議論の記述である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Internações por gripe crescem 92,9% e mortes pela doença avançam 10% em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza hospitalizations rise by 92.9% and deaths from the disease increase by 10% in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Influenza hospitalizations in Brazil surged in early 2026, with data through April 18 showing 4,658 hospitalizations and 259 influenza-related deaths, according to the Ministry of Health. This is contrasted with the same period in 2025, which recorded 2,414 hospitalizations and 259 deaths, implying a 92.9% increase in severe cases and a 10.03% rise in deaths. The report underscores a growing national burden of influenza and an uptick in hospital admission rates across the country through mid-April 2026. No laboratory details or symptom profiles are provided. The article concentrates on Brazil, with no information on other countries, and offers no data on infection sources or imported/exported cases. Published date anchors these figures to 2026, reflecting mid-April activity.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ入院数が92.9%増加、死亡数が2026年に10%増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでインフルエンザの入院数が大幅に増加し、重症度の基準に該当する可能性があるが、国際的拡大リスクや異常性の情報が限定的であり、詳細情報の継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内のインフルエンザ流行に関する公式保健データを報告しており、入院数の大幅増加（92.9%）と死亡数の増加（10%）が確認されている。ただし、これが異常・予想外であるか、または季節的パターンの範囲内であるかは不明。国際的拡大リスクについても記事では言及されていない。継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh giác viêm gan vi rút A: "Kẻ tấn công thầm lặng" lây qua đường ăn uống
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be wary of Hepatitis A: "the silent attacker" transmitted through food and drink.
article.articleSummary: A 25-year-old patient in Hanoi presented to E Hospital with fever up to 39°C and fatigue. Laboratory tests showed markedly elevated transaminases (AST 1028 U/L, ALT 529 U/L), leading to a diagnosis of acute hepatitis A (HAV infection). Hepatitis A is primarily transmitted fecal–oral via contaminated food or water; risk factors include poorly sanitized foods, raw or undercooked seafood from polluted waters, close daily contact, and unsafe sexual practices. Early symptoms resemble flu (fever, malaise, anorexia, myalgias, headache); progression includes jaundice, dark urine, pale stools. In adults, disease can be more severe. The patient developed jaundice on day 5; fever resolved with treatment. No specific antiviral exists; care was supportive, including liver-supportive therapy, rest, and nutrition. After 12 days, clinical status stabilized, bilirubin/enzymes improved, and discharge followed. Preventive measures: cooked meals, handwashing, and vaccination for children over 1 and high-risk adults, especially in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: A型肝炎に注意：「静かなる攻撃者」食飲から感染
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、社会的関心（見出しレベルの警告メッセージ）はあるが、IHR基準2つ以上該当する証拠がなく、情報が限定的。ベトナムの対象国であることと感染症の特性から経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告であるが、A型肝炎は食飲を介して集団発生のリスクが高く、ベトナムにおける環境衛生リスク（汚染された海産物など）が言及されている。記事は予防啓発の性質が強い。流行可能性と長期曝露リスク（不衛生な食品の継続的リスク）でWPRO基準2つが該当。継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC poursuit une vaste campagne de vaccination infantile contre la polio, la rougeole et la rubéole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC continues a large-scale childhood vaccination campaign against polio, measles, and rubella.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo launches a large-scale vaccination drive against polio, measles, and rubella, targeting over 23 million children across all provinces by Monday, 26 April 2026. Two parallel campaigns: polio vaccination in all 26 provinces reaching about 9 million children aged 0–5, aiming to eradicate polio after 18 deaths in 2025; and measles–rubella vaccination in 11 provinces—mostly in the West—seeking to inoculate about 23 million children aged 0–14. The country remains in a measles epidemic, with more than 82,000 suspected measles cases and around 1,200 deaths in 2025, amid a degraded health context, especially in the east where conflict and displacement persist and sanitation is poor. Report from Kinshasa by Paulina Zidi."}

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がポリオ、麻疹、風疹に対する大規模な小児予防接種キャンペーンを継続
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の流行（2025年に82,000件以上の疑似患者と約1,200人の死亡）と重症度の高さが認識される一方で、本記事は予防接種キャンペーンの進行状況報告であり、新たな危機的イベント検出ではなく、既知の流行への対応活動である。情報の一部が不明確なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事内容は既存の麻疹流行（2025年82,000+疑似患者、1,200人の死亡）への予防接種対応の報告である。ポリオについては2025年に18人の死亡が記載されている。新規の危機的なイベント検出というより、既知の感染症流行に対する対応活動の進捗報告と判断される。DRCは対象国リスト(203312)に含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi dengue task force: MCD to lead fight against mosquito diseases
article.articleSummary: Delhi government will create a special task force to intensify the fight against dengue and other mosquito-borne diseases ahead of the monsoon, to be led by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) commissioner and including the health department and civic agencies. The aim is rapid, ground-level action: monitor mosquito breeding spots, ensure timely fogging, improve sanitation, and mount stronger awareness campaigns; enhance surveillance, respond quickly to water stagnation and hygiene complaints, and fix inter-department coordination gaps. The move follows a 2021 Delhi High Court order directing tighter preventive steps, on-the-spot fines, better coordination and accountability. Dengue cases fluctuated: 1,072 (2020); 9,613 (2021); 4,469 (2022); 9,266 (2023); 6,391 (2024); 98 till 29 Mar 2025. Malaria: 228 (2020); 792 (2024); 23 till 29 Mar 2025. Chikungunya: 111 (2020); 267 (2024); 4 till 29 Mar 2025. Coordinated action is seen as key to making Delhi dengue-free within a fixed timeline.

triage.headline_ja: デリー蚊媒介感染症対策本部：MCD（デリー市営公社）が蚊媒介疾患との闘いを主導
triage.triage_reason: デンガー、マラリア、チクングニアの複数の蚊媒介疾患に関する予防的対策強化の記事。現在の症例数は低水準（2025年3月末時点でデンガー98件、マラリア23件、チクングニア4件）であり、即座のアウトブレイク状況ではなく、雨季前の行政的対応が主題である。情報不足を補う形での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は雨季前の予防的タスクフォース設置に関する行政ニュースであり、現在のアウトブレイク状況を示していない。2025年3月末時点での症例数は限定的。ただしデンガーの歴史的変動（2021年9,613件、2023年9,266件）および蚊媒介疾患の季節性リスク（雨季）を考慮し、今後の状況推移を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Alagamentos aumentam o risco de contrair leptospirose, alerta infectologista; veja como se prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flooding increases the risk of contracting leptospirosis, warns infectious disease specialist; see how to prevent it.
article.articleSummary: Flooding in Belém, Pará, Brazil raises leptospirosis risk as rainwater mingles with garbage, sewage and animal urine. Belém cases rose from 44 (2024) to 50 (2025); by March 2026, 22 cases were reported. In Pará state, 2024 saw 121 cases, 2025 had 152, and by March 2026 there were 16. Official data come from Sinan, used by Brazil’s Ministry of Health. Leptospira bacteria survive in contaminated sites and are brought to the surface by floodwaters; transmission occurs via skin or mucous membranes contact with tainted water, or ingestion, even if skin is intact. Early symptoms include high fever, headache, muscle pain (especially calves), nausea and loss of appetite; onset 1–30 days post-exposure. Severe forms can involve pulmonary hemorrhage, hemorrhagic manifestations, and Weil’s disease (jaundice, renal failure, bleeding). Diagnosis is via blood tests for antibodies or bacteria; treatment should begin promptly. Prevention focuses on avoiding contact with floodwater, which contains animal urine; other animals can carry the bacteria. Seek care at SUS units if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水によるレプトスピラ症感染リスク増加、感染症専門医が警告—予防方法を確認
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症の報告数増加傾向が認められ、環境因子（洪水）による拡大リスクが存在するが、全体的な重症度や異常性の詳細が限定的であり、情報が部分的である。
triage.notes: ブラジル（パラー州ベレン市）における洪水に伴うレプトスピラ症報告の増加を報道。2024年から2026年3月にかけて増加傾向が明確（ベレン市：44→50→22、パラー州：121→152→16）。洪水による長期曝露リスク、ヒト-ヒト以外の感染経路（汚染水との接触）が確認されている。ただし、死亡数や重症症例の具体的数値が記事サマリーに記載されていないため、重症度の判定は不明。ブラジルは医療インフラが相対的に整備されているため、国際支援の必要性は低いと判断。WPRO基準で3つ該当し情報不足が伴う典型的なWATCH案件。

article.articleHeadline: डॉन बॉस्को के छात्रों ने मलेरिया से बचाव का दिया संदेश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don Bosco's students gave a message on malaria prevention.
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day was observed at Don Bosco School in Pakur. The program featured student participation through speeches on malaria prevention and its adverse effects, along with drama performances and poster-making to showcase awareness messages. The activities aimed to alert the community about malaria and reinforce prevention practices. Principal Shiv Shankar Dubey highlighted preventive measures, including maintaining cleanliness, preventing water stagnation, and taking precautions to protect against mosquitoes. He urged students to stay informed and actively educate others in their surroundings, reinforcing local public health awareness and encouraging ongoing vigilance against malaria.

triage.headline_ja: ドン・ボスコの学生たちがマラリア予防に関するメッセージを発信
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はWHO世界マラリアデーのイベント報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク情報ではなく、教育活動の記事である。マラリア発生地域や重症度に関する具体的な情報がなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はジャールカンド州パクルのドン・ボスコ学校で実施された世界マラリアデーの啓発活動に関する報道である。実際の疾病発生やアウトブレイク情報ではなく、教育・啓発キャンペーンの内容に焦点を当てている。シグナル検出対象とならない。

article.articleHeadline: अग्रसेन स्कूल में मलेरिया पर जागरुकता कार्यक्रम आयोजित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria Awareness Program Organized at Agrasen School
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day, Saturday, April 25, 2026, Shri Agrasen School in Bhurkunda organized a malaria awareness program. Director Praveen Rajgadhia spoke to students about malaria, noting it is an infectious disease transmitted by the bite of female Anopheles mosquitoes. He outlined major symptoms—high fever, chills, headache, and weakness—and stressed that prevention hinges on awareness and everyday habits rather than medicines. The event featured a poster and slogan competition engaging students in malaria education. The program emphasized personal and community responsibility to reduce transmission and highlighted that protection stems from informed behavior. The school’s activity aligns with global public health messaging, aiming to raise vigilance against malaria through education and proactive prevention in Bhurkunda.

triage.headline_ja: アグラセン学校でマラリア啓発プログラムを開催
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドのジャールカンド州ブルクンダにおけるマラリア啓発活動の報道であり、新規の感染症発生事象ではなく教育イベントの報道に該当する。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界マラリアデーに関連した学校での啓発活動の報道であり、新規発生例・集団発生・異常な感染者数増加などの疫学的シグナルを含まない。既知疾患の予防啓発活動であり、感染症危機管理のトリアージ対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: India has cut malaria cases sharply but not fully eliminated it. Where do the gaps remain?
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains India's major burden despite sharp declines. Monsoon-driven vector breeding in waterlogged and forested districts sustains localized transmission even as national incidence falls from millions in the early 2000s to about 2.3 lakh in 2023 and deaths from 384 to 83. Globally, 2024 saw 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths. India is in a low-transmission phase and has exited HBHI, yet regional pockets persist: Mizoram and Tripura districts (Lunglei, Lawngtlai, Mamit, Siaha) and scattered areas in Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Meghalaya, Madhya Pradesh, Arunachal Pradesh, and Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Ladakh, Lakshadweep, and Puducherry have reported zero cases in recent years. Despite 120+ districts with no malaria in 2023, elimination remains hard due to asymptomatic infections and surveillance gaps. Continued district-focused interventions, strengthened surveillance and higher Annual Blood Examination Rate are needed to meet the 2030 elimination goal, along with vector control and stagnation prevention.

triage.headline_ja: インドはマラリア症例を急減させたが完全には排除していない。どこにギャップが残っているのか？
triage.triage_reason: インドにおけるマラリアの流行状況を分析する記事。症例数は急減しており国内的には低伝播段階にあるが、複数地域での局所的な持続的伝播と無症状感染による排除困難性が指摘されている。ただし急速な国際拡大リスクや渡航制限のリスクは明示されておらず、情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのマラリア排除に向けた進捗と残存する課題を報じるもの。症例数の大幅な減少（2023年約230万件）とオディシャ州、ミゾラム州、トリプラ州など複数地域での局所的伝播が確認されている。2030年排除目標に向けた継続的な介入の必要性が強調されており、国内的な公衆衛生上の関心は高い。ただし国際的な緊急度については記事に明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Após mortes por febre amarela, Lagoinha faz mutirão de vacinação neste sábado (23)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Following Yellow Fever Deaths, Lagoinha Holds a Vaccination Drive This Saturday (23).
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever in Lagoinha, interior Sao Paulo, Brazil, has caused two deaths in residents of Santa Rita and Canta Galo (April 3 and April 12), with one additional patient hospitalized under investigation. A vaccination drive is set for Saturday, April 25, 2026, from 8:00 to 14:00 at Praça da Matriz, open to all. The campaign follows deaths among rural residents with no vaccination history; Lagoinha's vaccination coverage is 37.72%, far below the 95% target. The event also offers influenza vaccination for prioritized groups. Health teams will provide dengue prevention guidance and elder-care information; medical students from Unitau will offer free checks for blood pressure, glucose, and weight. In the Vale do Paraiba, Cunha recorded the region's first 2026 yellow fever death on April 16; the region has five confirmed cases and three deaths (60% fatality). All patients were unvaccinated; the disease is transmitted by mosquitoes, not person-to-person.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病による死亡後、ラゴイニャが今週土曜日（23日）にワクチン接種活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのサンパウロ州で黄熱病による死亡が報告され、同時にインフルエンザとデング熱も言及されている。IHR基準で深刻な影響（死亡3例、致死率60%）と異常性が確認でき、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡、入院）と流行しやすさ（低いワクチン接種率37.72%対目標95%）が認められる。フルRRAへの進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのサンパウロ州ラゴイニャでの黄熱病アウトブレイクを主題としており、Vale do Paraíba地域で3例の死亡が確認されている。ワクチン接種率の低さ（37.72%）が継続的な曝露リスクを示唆している。インフルエンザとデング熱も同記事で言及されているが、主要な懸念は黄熱病である。

article.articleHeadline: बेंगलुरु में बर्ड फ्लू का प्रकोप काबू में, इंसानों में कोई मामला नहीं मिला : कर्नाटक स्वास्थ्य विभाग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu outbreak in Bengaluru under control; no human cases detected: Karnataka Health Department
article.articleSummary: Bird flu outbreak in Bengaluru under control; no human cases detected as of 25 April 2026. Karnataka Health Department said the H5N1 avian influenza outbreak at a poultry training center in the Hesarghatta area near Bengaluru was contained after 10 days of surveillance. First detected on 14 April and confirmed by NIHSAD, the outbreak prompted Rapid Response Teams to seal the infected zone (0–3 km) and establish a 3–10 km surveillance belt. All poultry at the center was culled; eggs and contaminated feed disposed per biosafety protocols. In the 10 km radius, 22 villages with 28,172 residents were monitored for 10 days. Nasopharyngeal/throat samples from quarantined staff tested negative for H5N1 at NIV Bengaluru; additional results pending. PPE, oseltamivir, viral transport media, and throat-swab kits stocked. Public advised to avoid sick/dead poultry and cook poultry products. 21 April sanitation certificate issued; poultry activities suspended for 90 days; fumigation 15 days.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルール鳥インフルエンザの流行は制御下、人間への感染例なし：カルナタカ州保健局
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの動物での確認と適切な封じ込めが報告されている。現在のところ人間への感染例はなく、感染症の公衆衛生への深刻な影響は限定的だが、H5N1は国際的関心が高い病原体のため、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: H5N1は高病原性インフルエンザで国際的な懸念病原体。現段階では動物での発生に限定され、人間への感染例がないが、定期的な検査結果追跡（NIV検査結果保留中）と継続的な疫学的監視が重要。当該地域での感染防止対策（90日間の家禽活動停止など）が適切に実施されている点は評価される。

article.articleHeadline: बेंगलुरु में बर्ड फ्लू का प्रकोप काबू में, इंसानों में कोई मामला नहीं मिला  कर्नाटक स्वास्थ्य विभाग | Bird Flu outbreak contained in Bengaluru, no human cases detected: Karnataka Health Dept
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu outbreak contained in Bengaluru, no human cases detected: Karnataka Health Department.
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza outbreak near Bengaluru, Karnataka, has been contained. On 25 April, the government reported that the poultry training center at Heserghatta, near Bengaluru, confirmed infection on 14 April after NIHSAD in Bhopal validated the virus. Rapid response teams were deployed; the infected zone covers 0–3 km with a 3–10 km surveillance belt. All poultry at the center were culled and eggs/feed disposed per biosafety protocols. Within a 10 km radius, 22 villages housing 28,172 residents were monitored for 10 days. On day 5, nasal and oropharyngeal swabs from quarantined staff tested negative at NIV Bengaluru; day-10 results are pending. No human H5N1 cases detected. Measures include ILIs/SARI surveillance, PPE, N95 masks, oseltamivir, viral transport media, and throat swab kits. A sanitation certificate was issued on 21 April; poultry activities at the center are suspended for 90 days with fumigation every 15 days. Public advised to cook poultry thoroughly and report sick birds.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルールの鳥インフルエンザの流行は管理下にあり、人間の症例は検出されていない：カルナタカ保健部門
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの確認事例が存在し異常・予想外（スクリーニング基準該当）だが、既に流行は制御下にあり人間感染がなく、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年4月25日時点の情報（未来日付のため検証不可）。H5N1確認事例があるが既に制御下にあり、人間感染なし。スクリーニング基準の異常性と流行しやすさで2項目該当するが、管理可能性が高く国際的リスクは低い。今後の人間感染確認、拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC poursuit une vaste campagne de vaccination infantile contre la polio, la rougeole et la rubéole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC continues a broad child immunization campaign against polio, measles and rubella.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is running two concurrent immunization campaigns: polio nationwide (26 provinces) targeting 9 million children aged 0–5 to eradicate polio, which caused 18 deaths in 2025, and measles-rubella across 11 provinces (mostly in the West) aiming to vaccinate 23 million children aged 0–14. The country remains in a measles-endemic situation; in 2025, more than 82,000 suspected measles cases and about 1,200 deaths were reported. The effort unfolds amid a weakened health system, especially in the East, where conflict has displaced millions living in poor sanitary conditions. Kinshasa-based correspondent Paulina Zidi notes these parallel campaigns reflect a broad public health push to protect children from vaccine-preventable diseases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がポリオ、麻疹、風疹に対する小児予防接種キャンペーンを継続
triage.triage_reason: ポリオ・麻疹・風疹の予防接種キャンペーン報道であり、既存の流行対応である。重篤度や国際的拡大リスクは相対的に低いが、DRCの脆弱な保健システムと東部の紛争による人道状況を背景とした公衆衛生の重要性から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: この記事は疾患の流行そのものではなく、既存の流行に対するワクチンキャンペーンの報道である。ただし2025年のポリオ死亡18件、麻疹疑い例82,000件以上、関連死亡約1,200件という基礎となる疾病負荷は深刻。脆弱な保健システムと東部紛争による人道状況が継続的な公衆衛生リスクとなっており、監視継続の価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Кто в России рискует заразиться новым китайским вирусом: симптомы, которые должны насторожить
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Who in Russia is at risk of contracting the new Chinese virus: symptoms that should raise concern.
article.articleSummary: CMNV, a virus linked to die-offs of shrimp and fish, poses a theoretical human infection risk in Russia from consuming raw or lightly salted seafood. The virus has been detected in dozens of marine species, and a Nature Microbiology study showed CMNV can infect humans, causing persistent ocular hypertension (POH-VAU)—an anterior uveitis with high intraocular pressure that can lead to optic-nerve atrophy and irreversible blindness if untreated. No confirmed POH-VAU cases in Russia have been reported, but CMNV is not yet part of routine diagnostics. Russia imports seafood from China and other Asian regions, and CMNV testing is not widely implemented, so risk remains theoretical. Higher-risk areas include the Far East, Moscow, St. Petersburg, and Kaliningrad, especially where raw fish is common. Defense: cook seafood to 63°C, choose certified products, maintain cold chain and sanitation; avoid raw or undercooked products from dubious sources; eat sushi/sashimi only at reputable venues.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで新しい中国ウイルスに感染するリスクのある人々：懸念を呼ぶべき症状
triage.triage_reason: 未確認の新興ウイルス（CMNV）による理論的なリスク警告だが、ロシアでは確認事例がなく、実際の脅威の程度が不明。情報の確認と動向監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は中国由来のウイルス（CMNV）についてであり、ロシアでの確認事例はまだ報告されていない。Bluedot APIが付与したロシアの地域情報（モスクワ、サンクトペテルブルク等）はリスク評価の対象地域として含まれているが、実際の発生地はロシアではなく中国が主。verified_locationsにはChinaのみを含める。ただしIHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当しているため、理論的リスクと国際的スプレッド可能性から監視対象（WATCH）とした。

article.articleHeadline: Município recebe selo nacional por boas práticas no combate à malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipality Receives National Seal for Best Practices in the Fight Against Malaria.
article.articleSummary: Malaria elimination advances in Rondônia, Brazil, as a municipality among five recognized with the Bronze Seal of Best Practices toward malaria elimination, announced at ExpoEpi 2026 in Brasília. The award goes to the unnamed municipality, joined by Candeias do Jamari, Guajará-Mirim, Itapuã do Oeste and Cujubim, under the National Plan for Malaria Elimination aiming for Brazil to achieve zero malaria by 2035. The Bronze Seal indicates attainment of initial targets: reduced malaria cases, expanded access to diagnosis, and rapid treatment initiation, with ongoing vector control and population guidance within the SUS framework. Local health teams conduct rapid tests, start treatment upon confirmation, and provide patient follow-up. Geisa Brasil Ribeiro, Director of the Department of Health Surveillance (Semusa), notes a turning point since 2024, with case reductions not seen for more than five years. Mayor Léo Moraes emphasizes continued prevention, diagnosis, and treatment to protect residents.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア対策優良事例として市が全国認定を獲得
triage.triage_reason: マラリア排除に向けた進展と成功事例の報道であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な新規イベントではない。症例数が減少している前向きな進展が主題である。
triage.notes: この記事はマラリア排除に向けた前向きな進展と公衆衛生施策の成功事例を報道するもの。新規感染症危機やアウトブレイクではなく、既存のマラリア問題における制御目標の達成を記録している。社会的・政治的関心は存在するが、IHRスクリーニング基準およびWPRO基準には合致しないため、シグナルとしてのピックアップは不要。

article.articleHeadline: Archäologie: Forscher enthüllen schmerzhaften Parasiten in römischer Toilette
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Archaeology: Researchers reveal painful parasites in a Roman toilet.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 April 2026, archaeologists analyzing Roman latrine deposits at Novae and Marcianopolis near Svishtov, Bulgaria, along the lower Danube, identified parasites previously undocumented in the region. Mineralized residues on ceramic surfaces were rehydrated, filtered, and examined; after 400x microscopy, parasite remnants and eggs were detected. Combined DNA analysis and an antibody-based immunological assay confirmed Cryptosporidium, marking the earliest securely attested find in the Mediterranean and challenging the view that this parasite originated in Central America. The team also identified Entamoeba histolytica–related amebic dysentery (severe bloody-mucus diarrhea, abdominal pain, fever) and cestode eggs, indicating consumption of raw or undercooked meat. At Novae, samples showed strong infestation—likely from Danube water contamination or faulty aqueducts—while Marcianopolis samples from a workshop showed none, implying legionaries there had access to cleaner water and healthier diets. Highlights ancient parasite prevalence.

triage.headline_ja: 考古学：ローマ時代のトイレから痛みを伴う寄生虫が発見
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は古代ローマ時代（約2000年前）の考古学的な歴史的発見であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。現代の公衆衛生上の脅威や流行性疾患には該当しない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが検出した発生地域（ブルガリア、ブラジル、米国、ギリシャなど）は考古学的遺跡の所在地であり、現在の感染症イベント発生地ではない。記事は歴史的な寄生虫検出の考古学的研究報告であり、EBS監視対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Arunachal CM calls for collective push to eliminate malaria by 2030
article.articleSummary: Arunachal Pradesh Chief Minister Pema Khandu announced on World Malaria Day, 25 April 2026, that 19 districts in the state are malaria-free, part of an ongoing drive to eliminate malaria by 2030. The state had moved from high burden to Category I (low burden) in 2022, reflecting progress by health workers and communities. Despite gains, the CM urged continued action and described malaria elimination as a people’s movement. Preventive measures emphasized include long-lasting insecticidal nets, eliminating stagnant water, wearing protective clothing during peak mosquito activity, using indoor repellents, and seeking immediate testing for fever. The statement, from Itanagar, highlights sustained efforts to maintain gains and reach total malaria freedom across Arunachal Pradesh by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: アルナーチャル・プラデーシュ州首相が2030年までのマラリア根絶に向けた集団行動を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの継続的な排除達成に向けた前向きな進捗報告。新規の感染症危機や異常な発生ではなく、既存の公衆衛生プログラムの成功事例であり、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準の該当がない。
triage.notes: 記事はWorld Malaria Day（4月25日）に際した州首相による宣言で、マラリア根絶に向けた継続的な取り組みと既に達成した進捗（19地区でマラリア排除、2022年にCategory I移行）を強調しているもの。新規の感染症危機シグナルではなく、公衆衛生プログラムの成功報告である。

article.articleHeadline: Egy halálos afrikai vírus miatt aggódnak a kutatók: hasonlóan terjed, mint a Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers are worried about a deadly African virus: it spreads similarly to COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: Lujo virus, a highly lethal arenavirus, was first identified in 2008 in Zambia and South Africa, named from Lusaka and Johannesburg. The initial case was a 36-year-old Zambian travel organizer; the outbreak killed five people (80% mortality): two healthcare workers and three others, with the fifth survivor after precautions were implemented. Transmission is likely via body fluids, with the highest risk in the last three days of illness. Two weeks after exposure, fever, headache, and myalgia emerge, followed by rash, facial/neck swelling, diarrhea, and sore throat; hemorrhagic fever is not typical. Death typically occurs 10–13 days after symptom onset. Lujo is unique in the Arenaviridae family for using human neuropilin-2 to enter cells. No new cases have been documented since 2008, but its zoonotic origin maintains concern for global health systems under strain.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者らが懸念する致命的なアフリカウイルス：COVID-19と同様に拡散する
triage.triage_reason: 2008年以降の新規症例報告がなく、現在のアクティブな流行ではないが、高い致死率（80%）と人獣共通感染症としての潜在リスク、および国際的な公衆衛生への懸念が存在するため、継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Lujo virusは2008年の初発・拡大時に5名の死亡例を記録した高致死率ウイルスであるが、その後18年間新規症例が報告されていない。現在のアクティブな流行情報ではなく、歴史的かつ潜在的なリスク評価の記事と判断される。南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations はザンビアのみとした。記事サマリーにはCOVID-19との伝播様式の比較があるが、これは疾病学的特性の説明であり、現在のCOVID-19流行との関連ではない。
