article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu Outbreak Near Bengaluru Contained; No Human Cases Detected, Says Health Department
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (H5N1) outbreak at a government poultry training centre in Mathkuru village, Hesaraghatta, near Bengaluru, detected April 14 and confirmed by NIHSAD, Bhopal. By a 10-day surveillance, no human cases detected so far. An infected 0–3 km zone and 3–10 km surveillance zone were established; culling of all birds at the centre and safe disposal of eggs and contaminated feed. About 28,172 people across 22 villages within the 10-km zone were monitored. Nasopharyngeal samples from quarantined staff on day 5 tested negative for H5N1 at NIV Bengaluru; day 10 samples awaited. Sanitisation certificate issued April 21; poultry activities suspended for 90 days with biweekly disinfection. Public advisory to avoid handling or consuming meat/eggs from sick/dead poultry; ensure cooking kills virus. Healthcare facilities urged to monitor ILI/SARI and maintain PPE, antivirals, viral transport media, and throat swab kits.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルール近郊の鳥インフルエンザアウトブレイク封じ込め；人感染例なし、保健当局発表
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの確認事例（異常/予想外）、10日間の能動的サーベイランス実施中で長期曝露リスク有、複数州にまたがる対応（異常性・対象国での関心度合い考慮）。IHR基準で異常性と国際拡大リスクに該当、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・曝露継続・流行可能性・管理可能性で複数該当。
triage.notes: H5N1ウイルスの確認事例であり、ベンガルール（カルナータカ州）とボーパール（中央部）の複数州にまたがる対応体制が敷かれている。現在のところ人感染例はないが、10日間サーベイランス継続中で、22村・約28,172人が監視下にある。ニパウイルスも疾患リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーでは言及されていないため、主要な懸念はH5N1鳥インフルエンザに集約されている。

article.articleHeadline: Distrito Federal registra 29 casos importados de malária em 2025 - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal District records 29 imported malaria cases in 2025 - Jornal de Brasília.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Brazil’s Federal District shows no local transmission but 29 imported cases were recorded in 2025. All patients were treated and cured; seven required hospitalization. The SES-DF also investigated 110 probable cases, totaling 211 suspected or monitored occurrences. Cases involve travelers from the Amazon region—particularly indigenous areas—and from Africa, notably Angola, which experienced a December outbreak the previous year. Of the 29 infections, 19 reside in the Federal District; 10 in Goiás, Amazonas, Pará, Acre, Paraná, and Santa Catarina. All cases were diagnosed in the capital. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium species (P. vivax, P. falciparum, P. malariae, P. ovale, P. knowlesi, P. simium) and transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes; there is no direct person-to-person transmission. The regional health network uses mobile teams; travelers should consult the HRAN Traveler Desk for prevention and testing, and arrivals from endemic areas with fever should seek care.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦地区が2025年にマラリアの輸入症例29件を報告 - ブラジリア日報
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるマラリア輸入症例の監視報告。局所伝播がなく、症例が限定的で管理下にあるため、IHR基準の複数該当なし。ただし、アフリカ地域（特にアンゴラ）との関連性と継続的な監視の必要性から、経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の輸入マラリア症例報告。局所伝播がなく、全症例が治療・治癒済みで、公衆衛生上の即座の脅威は低い。アンゴラとの関連性は地域検証の対象外（アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれない）。蚊媒介による局所伝播リスクは低く評価。

article.articleHeadline: World Malaria Day Special : गेल्यावर्षी पुण्यात आढळले ३५ हिवताप रुग्ण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Malaria Day Special: 35 typhoid fever patients detected in Pune last year.
article.articleSummary: Pune, India marked World Malaria Day with attention to the city’s mosquito-borne disease burden. Malaria, spread by Anopheles mosquitoes, remains an urban public health challenge in Pune, driven by poor sanitation and standing water that supports mosquito breeding. The article notes last year Pune recorded 35 malaria cases, while this year has seen 3 cases detected to date. Health authorities emphasized that preventing water stagnation is essential to curb transmission. The piece highlights the ongoing urban risk from mosquito proliferation rather than a large-scale outbreak, and calls for community action to reduce breeding sites. There is no mention of laboratory confirmation details or imported cases in the brief. The message underscores vector control and sanitation as key to reducing malaria in Pune.

triage.headline_ja: World Malaria Day Special：昨年プネーで35人のマラリア患者が検出
triage.triage_reason: プネーにおける35件/年のマラリア症例は風土病レベルの流行であり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当せず、また2026年の新規症例も3件と限定的である。社会的・政治的関心はWorld Malaria Day記念報道に限定される。
triage.notes: プネーのマラリアはWorld Malaria Day関連の地方記事であり、流行警報ではなく周年啓発キャンペーン。症例数は低く（昨年35件、今年3件）、既知の公衆衛生課題の定期的なモニタリング報道と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly protein report: China livestock sector on alert as new foot-and-mouth strain emerges
article.articleSummary: China's livestock sector is on alert as a new foot-and-mouth disease strain emerges. In the United States hog complex, disease pressure remains elevated: porcine epidemic diarrhea virus (PEDv) positivity on sow farms surged to its highest level since 2022 this winter, and porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus (PRRSV) rates have climbed year over year. PEDv is particularly disruptive because it kills most infected newborn piglets, directly reducing future hog supply, while PRRSV adds ongoing production stress. These disease dynamics help explain why the US breeding herd has remained flat despite supportive price signals and a seasonal downturn in slaughter usually seen into July. The report links disease-driven supply constraints with ongoing export demand, noting pork prices and cutouts have shown resilience within a tightening, disease-influenced backdrop. The title underscores China’s FMD concern, framing a global disease context for the sector.

triage.headline_ja: 週次タンパク質レポート：新しい口蹄疫株が出現する中、中国の畜産セクターが警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: 中国での新規口蹄疫株の出現は異常かつ予想外であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行性）に該当。口蹄疫は動物疾患であるが国際的な影響と経済的影響を持つため、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事は中国での新規口蹄疫株の出現を主題としている。米国での豚疾患（PEDv、PRRSV）についても記載されているが、見出しの焦点は中国の口蹄疫であり、グローバルな畜産セクターへの影響を示唆している。口蹄疫は動物疾患であるが、国際的な貿易制限と経済的な懸念が高い。対象国リストではChinaのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: CMO Office Organizes Malaria Eradication Seminar and Oath Ceremony in Azamgarh | Azamgarh News: आजमगढ़ में मलेरिया उन्मूलन संगोष्ठी, अधिकारियों और कर्मचारियों ने ली शपथ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CMO Office Organizes Malaria Eradication Seminar and Oath Ceremony in Azamgarh | Azamgarh News: Malaria Eradication Seminar in Azamgarh, Officials and Employees Took an Oath
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day events in Azamgarh were held at the CMO office, featuring a malaria elimination seminar and an oath-taking ceremony. The program, chaired by Chief Medical Officer Dr. N. R. Verma, highlighted the theme: 'Committed to eliminating malaria: now we can and we must.' He noted that Azamgarh district has reported no indigenous malaria cases in the past four years, a result of coordinated efforts. Malaria control activities include timely testing of suspected fever patients, prompt drug distribution and complete treatment, larval source management, vector-control measures, and community awareness campaigns. The event commended ASHA workers, ANMs, health staff, and the malaria/filaria department for door-to-door outreach. Attendees pledged full commitment to elimination. Senior officials present included Deputy CMO/ Nodal Vector-borne Dr. Avinash Jha, Additional CMO Dr. Abdul Aziz, Deputy CMO Dr. Aalendra Kumar, District Malaria Officer Anil Srivastav, and publicity in-charge Manish Tiwari.

triage.headline_ja: CMO Office Organizes Malaria Eradication Seminar and Oath Ceremony in Azamgarh | Azamgarh News: アーザムガル地区でマラリア撲滅セミナーと誓約式が開催
triage.triage_reason: 記事はマラリア撲滅キャンペーンと啓発活動のイベント報道であり、疾病の流行や危機的状況を示す情報がない。アーザムガル地区では過去4年間で地元感染例がないとされており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の流行を報じるものではなく、政府保健機関によるマラリア撲滅啓発活動と記念式典の報道である。実際の症例発生や公衆衛生上の危機を示すシグナル要素がないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定した。

article.articleHeadline: Baixa umidade e calor ditam aumento da influenza em Campo Grande; saiba como se proteger
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Low humidity and heat drive a rise in influenza in Campo Grande; learn how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Rising influenza and other viral respiratory infections in Campo Grande are linked to low humidity and rapid temperature fluctuations during autumn and winter. Fiocruz reports a growing trend in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases, with children under 2 among the most affected. SRAG can be caused by influenza, SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19), and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), among others. Cold, dry air weakens mucosal defenses and can boost viral replication, including rhinovirus in chilly mornings. To reduce risk, experts advise: protect the airways in cold hours with masks and scarves; stay hydrated and perform nasal saline 1–2 times daily; avoid intense outdoor exercise when cold/dry; limit smoke and irritants; maintain moderate indoor humidity with proper ventilation and clean HVAC systems; asthma and rhinitis patients should use controller medications as prescribed; seek care immediately if alarm signs appear (shortness of breath at rest, persistent wheeze, high fever, chest pain, or a large drop in peak flow).

triage.headline_ja: 低湿度と熱がカンポ・グランデのインフルエンザ増加を引き起こす；自己防護方法を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける複数の呼吸器ウイルス感染症（インフルエンザ、COVID-19、RSV）の増加が報告されており、スクリーニング基準で異常性・重症度が認められるが、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクについて明確な記述がなく、また情報が不足しているため。
triage.notes: IHR基準で2つ該当、WPRO基準で4つ該当し、理論上はPICKUPの候補であるが、記事サマリーが地域的な季節性疾患増加の啓発主体であり、公衆衛生上の重大事象（大規模流行、致死性急増、対応能力超過）の明確な証拠が示されていない。Fiocruzの報告はあるが具体的な患者数や増加率の記載がないため、情報不足からWATCHとした。続報で流行規模や重症度の詳細情報が提供される場合はPICKUP昇格の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue y alerta por reaparición del DENV-3: ampliarán zonas de vacunación, dice Salud Pública - Nacionales - ABC Color
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue and alert over the reappearance of DENV-3: vaccination zones will be expanded, says Public Health.
article.articleSummary: Dengue serotype DENV-3 has reappeared in Paraguay, with the first case detected in Asunción in a person who recently returned from Brazil. The Public Health Ministry confirms this year’s first DENV-3 case, prompting expansion of vaccination by the Expanded Immunization Program (PAI) to the Central Department and new cities Villarrica and Coronel Oviedo. Paraguay has 70,200 Qdenga doses, but uptake is low: about 3,800 doses have been used since immunization began in November 2025. The eligible age remains up to 39 years; no extension to older groups. PAI Director Luis Cousirat says more high-transmission regions will be enabled next week. Qdenga is tetravalent and protects against four dengue serotypes; efficacy against DENV-3 is slightly lower but still prevents severe disease, hospitalization, and death. Authorities urge vaccination plus elimination of mosquito breeding sites at home.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とDENV-3の再出現による警戒：保健省が予防接種範囲を拡大
triage.triage_reason: パラグアイでのDENV-3再出現は異常かつ予想外であり、複数の基準に該当するが、現時点での死亡報告や深刻な公衆衛生影響の明確な記述がなく、対象国内での発生でないため情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はパラグアイでのDENV-3再出現だが、パラグアイはCEPR対象国リストに含まれていない。発生地域にBrazilが列挙されているが、記事サマリーではブラジルは感染者が最近訪問した渡航源としてのみ言及されており、ブラジルでの実際の発生が主題ではない。ワクチン接種率が低く（3,800/70,200線量）、ベクター対策と組み合わせた対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: हल्का बुखार इग्नोर करना पड़ सकता है भारी, हो सकता है मलेरिया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ignoring a mild fever could be serious; it could be malaria.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a serious threat. World Malaria Day 2026 (April 25) highlights awareness that mild fever, chills, or weakness can signal malaria in India and beyond. Transmission occurs from bites of female Anopheles mosquitoes. Common symptoms include high fever, chills, headache, body pains, and weakness; many cases also feature nausea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, and dark urine, with yellowing of the eyes indicating possible jaundice. Early malaria often presents as mild fever and fatigue, frequently mistaken for flu or dengue, but fever in malaria tends to rise and fall in a cycle and is not constant. Although India has reduced cases, seasonal spikes continue to challenge patients and clinicians. Prevention emphasizes mosquito repellents and wearing long sleeves, along with prompt diagnosis and treatment to prevent progression.

triage.headline_ja: 軽い熱を無視することは危険かもしれない。マラリアの可能性がある。
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは既知の風土病であり、World Malaria Dayの啓発記事という文脈。IHR基準は該当しないが、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常性/予想外」「流行しやすさ」に該当する要素があり、インドに関連する疾患情報として経過観察の価値あり。
triage.notes: 記事は World Malaria Day 2026 の啓発キャンペーン性が強く、新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。マラリアは既知の風土病であり、インドでは「季節的なスパイク」として管理されている状況。Dengue、Influenza も言及されているが、記事の主題はマラリア。情報は主に啓発内容であり、緊急のリスク信号とは判定されない。

article.articleHeadline: Ninh Bình triển khai các biện pháp khẩn cấp ngăn chặn vi rút lở mồm long móng serotype SAT1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ninh Binh deploys emergency measures to prevent foot-and-mouth disease virus serotype SAT1.
article.articleSummary: Emergency measures are being deployed in Ninh Binh Province, Vietnam, to prevent the incursion of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) virus serotype SAT1, described as a new strain with rapid transmission. The Ninh Binh provincial People’s Committee issued document No. 2651/UBND-VP3, directing ministries, sectors, and local authorities to implement synchronized disease-prevention measures on livestock. The move responds to the risk of SAT1 entering the region; the report does not indicate any current outbreaks. No active outbreak is reported. The measures emphasize proactive surveillance, biosecurity, and coordinated control across relevant departments. Publication time: 25 April 2026, 19:24. Source: Phuc An / Nha bao va Cong luan.

triage.headline_ja: ニン・ビン省が口蹄疫ウイルスSAT1血清型の流入を防ぐため緊急対策を展開
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（動物疾患）の予防的対策が報告されているが、現在のところ実際の発生は報告されていない。対象国ベトナムで新血清型SAT1の流入リスク検出のため情報動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物疾患（口蹄疫）であり、ヒト感染のリスクはない。記事は現在のところ「新血清型SAT1の流入リスク」への予防的措置を報告しており、実際の発生事例は報告されていない。ただしSAT1は畜産業に深刻な影響を与える可能性があり、ベトナム当局が高い関心を示していることから経過観察が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Seis em cada dez cidades do Sul de MG estão em alerta ou alto risco de transmissão de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six out of ten cities in southern Minas Gerais are on alert or at high risk of dengue transmission
article.articleSummary: First-quarter 2026 LIRAa data show sixty percent of southern Minas Gerais cities are in alert or high risk for dengue transmission. The region has 70 municipalities in risk (≥3.9%), 23 in alert (1–3.9%), and 67 with satisfactory indices (≤0.99%), with 30 reporting zero; five cities—Bocaina de Minas, Fama, Lavras, Marmelópolis, and Wenceslau Braz—were not surveyed due to data gaps. Among high-risk towns, Itumirim (8.10%), Bandeira do Sul (7.7%), Cássia (7.10%), Andradas (6.8%), and Pouso Alegre (6.1%) show the highest infestation rates. statewide, January–March 2026 data indicate 213 satisfactory, 422 in alert, and 184 in risk. LIRAa is a quarterly, sample-based survey: health teams visit randomly selected homes to identify standing water and collect Aedes aegypti larvae, computing an infestation index to guide dengue, chikungunya, and Zika control actions in the Sul de Minas.

triage.headline_ja: 南ミナスジェライス州の10都市中6都市がデング熱感染の警戒または高リスク状態にある
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの南部ミナスジェライス州でデングを中心とした蚊媒介感染症の拡大リスクが報告されているが、重症度情報や国際的拡大の具体的懸念が明記されていない。引き続き情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ミナスジェライス州南部の複数都市でLIRAa調査に基づくデング等の媒介蚊指数が高いことを報告。季節的な蚊媒介感染症の周知のための情報発表と考えられ、IHR基準による緊急性は低い。ただしデング、チクングニア、ジカの3疾患が対象であり、蚊媒介感染症としての継続的な監視が必要。死亡事例や入院率などの重症度情報が欠落している。

article.articleHeadline: Quảng Ninh chủ động chặn dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quảng Ninh Province Takes Proactive Measures to Contain African Swine Fever.
article.articleSummary: On 25 April 2026, Quảng Ninh Province, Vietnam, reports a resurgence of African swine fever (ASF) in Van Đồn District. The latest outbreak is at Đỗ Văn Quang’s pig farm in Cai Bau hamlet; after lab confirmation of ASF, the entire herd (100 pigs) was culled. Surrounding facilities and areas were disinfected to prevent spread. This marks the second ASF outbreak in Van Đồn since early April, the first at Dien Xa hamlet affecting eight pig-keeping households. To contain the epidemic, authorities supplied 500 liters of disinfectant and 8.5 tons of lime and tightened controls on pig movement. With about 300,000 pigs in Quảng Ninh, the provincial government issued Directive 1495/UBND-TC to bolster biosafety, reporting, and surveillance, form village anti-epidemic teams, and require disposal of infected/suspect pigs within 24 hours of test results; penalties apply for concealment and late reporting.

triage.headline_ja: 広寧省がアフリカ豚コレラの蔓延を主動的に阻止
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおいてアフリカ豚コレラの複数発生が確認され、省レベルの厳格な対応が取られている。動物衛生上の重大な影響と異常性が認められ、IHR基準に該当する可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは広寧省（ベトナム北東部）の複数地区での ASF 発生を報告。4月初旬以降に2件の発生が確認され、約30万頭の豚を飼育する同省での蔓延リスクが高い。省政府による指令 1495 号で生物防除の強化、報告義務、24時間以内の廃棄などが規定されており、当局の危機意識が高い。動物疾患であるため人間への直接的な脅威は低いが、地域的な食糧安全保障と経済的影響の観点から重要。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo mostra relação entre dengue e síndrome de Guillain‑Barré
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study shows relationship between dengue and Guillain-Barré syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's 2024 dengue epidemic was the largest in history, with about 6.5 million probable cases and over 5,800 deaths. Most dengue patients have fever, body aches, malaise, and rash. By 2025, around 1.6 million probable cases were reported; 2026 Fiocruz projections foresee about 2 million cases. A NEJM study using Brazilian SUS data quantified the dengue-Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) link. Using a self-controlled case-series across hospitalizations, dengue notifications, and deaths (2023–2024), researchers identified more than 5,000 GBS hospitalizations, 89 occurring soon after dengue infection. Relative risk after dengue was ~17-fold during weeks 1–6, ~30-fold in weeks 1–2, returning to baseline after 6 weeks; about 36 per million dengue cases develop GBS. Early treatment with IV immunoglobulin or plasmapheresis is crucial; Brazil's SUS offers 136 specialized rehab centers. Prevention emphasizes Aedes aegypti control and vaccination; dengue vaccine has been available since 2024, with Butantan expanding target ages.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とギラン・バレー症候群の関連性を示す研究
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱の大規模流行（2024年に665万件の疑い例、5,800人以上の死亡）とギラン・バレー症候群との関連性が新たに定量化されました。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常/予想外の合併症リスクが認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度と長期曝露が該当します。
triage.notes: 2024年のブラジル・デング流行は過去最大規模で、2026年の予測では200万件の症例が見込まれています。デング感染後のギラン・バレー症候群発症リスクが17～30倍に増加することが新たに定量化されました。デング感染者100万人あたり約36人がGBSを発症する見込みです。ブラジルではワクチン接種推進とネッタイシマカ対策、IV免疫グロブリン治療や血漿交換療法が利用可能です。

article.articleHeadline: Cidade da Grande BH confirma raiva em morcego encontrado morto e abre vacinação emergencial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Greater Belo Horizonte City confirms rabies in a bat found dead and launches emergency vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a dead bat in Capelinha, Betim (Grande Belo Horizonte), triggering an emergency domestic animal vaccination campaign in the area. The bat was collected by a primary health unit and laboratory-confirmed positive. The Center for Zoonoses and Endemics (CCZE) initiated a 500-meter containment around the spot, with door-to-door outreach, resident guidance, and transmission-control measures. An emergency vaccination drive for dogs and cats is scheduled in Capelinha on Saturday, 8:00–17:00, at CAIC (Avenida Nova York, 341), targeting pets not yet reached by prior visits. Authorities urge keeping pet vaccinations up to date, and monitoring for signs such as aggression, excessive salivation, or apathy; suspected cases should be reported to CCZE immediately. Do not touch bats; only trained teams should remove them. For inquiries, contact CCZE Betim via listed phone numbers or WhatsApp.

triage.headline_ja: グレーター・ベロ・オリゾンテの都市が死亡したコウモリからの狂犬病を確認し、緊急予防接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでコウモリから確認された狂犬病事例だが、人への感染は報告されておらず、動物での散発的な発症である。地域的な予防接種対応が既に実施されているため、現時点では国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は動物（コウモリ）からの狂犬病確認であり、人感染例ではない。地域当局による迅速な対応（500m境界設定、緊急予防接種キャンペーン）が実施されている。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。長期曝露と流行しやすさの観点から WPRO基準2項目に該当するが、重症度と異常性が低く、国際的拡大リスクがないため WATCH 判定。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Bengaluru Bird Flu: H5N1 Outbreak Contained After 10-Day Surveillance Drive; No Human Cases Detected
article.articleSummary: Bengaluru, India – H5N1 avian influenza outbreak contained after a 10-day surveillance drive. An infected zone within 0-3 km and a 3-10 km surveillance zone were established around the outbreak site. All birds at the affected centre were culled and eggs and contaminated feed disposed per biosecurity protocols. The surveillance covered 28,172 residents across 22 villages over 10 days. Nasopharyngeal samples from quarantined staff collected on day five tested negative for H5N1 at NIV Bengaluru; day ten samples were sent for testing and results are awaited. No human H5N1 cases have been detected in either the infected or surveillance zones to date. Health facilities were asked to monitor ILI and SARI, maintain PPE, triple-layer masks, oseltamivir, viral transport media, and throat swab kits. A sanitisation certificate was issued April 21; poultry activities remain suspended 90 days with disinfection every 15 days.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルール鳥インフルエンザ：H5N1アウトブレイク、10日間の監視活動後に封じ込め；ヒト感染例検出なし
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザのアウトブレイクが確認されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する（異常性、重症度、流行可能性）。ただし現時点で人間感染が検出されておらず、アウトブレイクは既に封じ込められている状況であるため、追加情報の経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、H5N1の鳥類感染は確認されているが、現時点で人間感染例は検出されていない。アウトブレイク対応は実施済み（感染鶏の全数淘汰、バイオセキュリティプロトコール遵守、監視区域設定）。ただしH5N1は人獣共通感染症であり、ヒト感染のリスクが存在するため、検体検査結果の追跡が重要。社会的・政治的関心が発生しているため経過観察の対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly pig report: Disease pressure adds increased risk to hog supply outlook
article.articleSummary: PEDv and PRRSV rising across the US hog herd are limiting herd expansion and piglet survival, tightening future supplies and increasing volatility. June lean hog futures slipped, while the CME lean hog index edged up, and cash prices hovered near the high $70s to low $90s per cwt depending on measure, signaling mixed near-term signals amid a bullish longer-term outlook due to supply constraints. US pork net sales for 2026 fell to 16,100 MT (marketing-year low), down 57% week over week, with total exports at 38,200 MT to destinations including Mexico, Japan, South Korea, China and Colombia; reductions were seen for the Philippines, Australia and New Zealand. The seasonal pattern of tightening is amplified by disease pressures, with PEDv killing many newborn piglets and PRRSV adding stress, potentially extending supply constraints into fall. Separately, China reports SAT1 FMD detections across distant provinces, prompting a nationwide vaccine push.

triage.headline_ja: Weekly pig report: Disease pressure adds increased risk to hog supply outlook（週間豚レポート：疾病圧力が豚供給見通しにリスク増加をもたらす）
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）が中国で複数の地域で検出され、全国的なワクチン推進が実施されている。これは国際的な家畜生産と貿易に影響を及ぼすIHR通知相当の事象であり、社会的・経済的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な内容はPEDvとPRRSVによる米国養豚業への影響であるが、特に重要な情報として中国での口蹄疫（SAT1 FMD）複数地域での検出と全国的なワクチン推進が報告されている。対象国のうちフィリピンはUS pork exportの削減対象として言及されており、中国は口蹄疫の発生地として明確に述べられている。日本、韓国、コロンビア、メキシコ、オーストラリア、ニュージーランドは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: अरुणाचल से 2030 तक मलेरिया को खत्म करने के लिए सामूहिक प्रयास करें: मुख्यमंत्री
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Join forces to eradicate malaria by 2030 in Arunachal Pradesh: Chief Minister.
article.articleSummary: Arunachal Pradesh, India — On World Malaria Day (April 25), Chief Minister Pema Khandu announced that 19 districts in the state are malaria-free, marking progress toward the goal of complete elimination by 2030. He noted that the state shifted from a high-burden status in 2022 to Category-1 (low burden) and urged residents to unite in a mass movement to eradicate malaria. Khandu also encouraged simple mosquito-prevention practices and stated, in a social media post, that this achievement reflects the dedication of health workers and communities. The announcement highlights sustained malaria-control efforts in the northeastern state, with 19 districts now malaria-free and ongoing emphasis on prevention to maintain elimination.

triage.headline_ja: アルナーチャル・プラデーシュ州で2030年までにマラリアを根絶するための集団的取り組みを：首席大臣
triage.triage_reason: マラリア制御の進展を報告する公式声明であり、異常性や緊急性がなく、既知の疾患の改善トレンドを示している。IHR基準、スクリーニング基準ともに該当せず。
triage.notes: 本記事はアルナーチャル・プラデーシュ州におけるマラリア対策の成功事例を報告するもの。19地区がマラリア無発生状態を達成し、2022年の高負荷状態からカテゴリ1（低負荷）への改善を記載。異常な発生、重症度の上昇、拡大傾向は認められず、むしろ制御進展を示す。世界マラリアデーの文脈での公式声明であり、危機管理シグナルとしてピックアップの必要性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Projeto mobiliza estudantes em ação de combate à dengue e educação cidadã em São Gonçalo do Sapucaí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Project mobilizes students in a dengue-control campaign and civic education in São Gonçalo do Sapucaí.
article.articleSummary: São Gonçalo do Sapucaí, Brazil, hosts a dengue-control and civic-education initiative where 5th-year students from the municipal school participate in the Escola Consciente, Cidade Saudável project. The effort goes beyond a typical educational contest, engaging students in practical actions to identify and eliminate potential Aedes aegypti breeding sites and to promote proper waste disposal. The program fuses education with public health in a preventive strategy, aiming to turn pupils into information multipliers within their families and the broader community. It underscores the school’s role as a space for health, environment, and social participation, and by involving children in preventive measures, seeks to build a culture of community care and advance dengue control in the municipality.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策と市民教育キャンペーンに学生を動員するプロジェクト（ブラジル・サンゴンサーロ・ド・サプカイ市）
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は教育キャンペーンおよび予防啓発活動に関するもので、新規の感染症発生報告ではない。IHR基準・スクリーニング基準いずれも該当せず、社会的懸念も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は新規のデング熱患者発生や異常な流行ではなく、ブラジルの地方自治体による予防教育プロジェクトである。シグナル検知の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria, in 25 anni evitati 2,3 miliardi di casi e 14 milioni di morti - Medicina - Ansa.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria: 2.3 billion cases and 14 million deaths prevented in 25 years.
article.articleSummary: Over the last 25 years, 2.3 billion malaria cases and 14 million deaths were prevented worldwide, WHO reports on World Malaria Day 2026. Yet stagnation raises concern and calls for increased funding to finish the job. The push benefits from vaccines, therapies, and vector-control tools, including genetically modified mosquitoes. Vaccination programs protect about 10 million children annually in 25 countries, with near-90% case reductions in the Greater Mekong region despite drug resistance. Forty-seven countries are malaria-free; 37 reported fewer than 1,000 cases in 2024. Endemic malaria now persists in 80 countries (down from 108). New-generation nets account for 84% of recent distributions (vs 10% in 2019). Vaccinations are in 25 countries; chemoprevention reached 54 million children. In 2024, 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths occurred globally, up slightly from 2023.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア：25年間で23億件の発症と1400万人の死亡を防止
triage.triage_reason: WHO世界マラリアデー報告による全球的な進展状況の報告であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクではない。特定国での異常な疾病発生を示すイベント情報ではなく、公衆衛生上の進捗レポートである。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHO世界マラリアデー2026における25年間の感染防止成果の全球的報告である。新規アウトブレイク、異常発生、または急速な国際拡大を示すイベント情報ではない。Greater Mekong region（ベトナム、タイを含む）での進展が言及されているが、これは流行抑制の成功事例であり、新規シグナルではない。Bluedot APIが複数国を発生地域として抽出しているが、本記事は特定国での新規感染症イベントではなく、公衆衛生上のグローバルトレンド報告であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados concentra 42% de todas as mortes por chikungunya no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados accounts for 42% of all chikungunya deaths in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Dourados accounts for 42% of chikungunya deaths in Brazil in 2026, per the Health Ministry arboviral panel. Nationally 20 chikungunya deaths have been recorded, with 13 in Mato Grosso do Sul and eight in Dourados, most among Indigenous communities. The city reports 6,186 probable cases, a 64.9% test-positivity rate, and hospital bed occupancy around 110% of capacity. In response, the municipality declared a public health calamity and civil defense emergency and opened emergency recruitment for doctors and nurses to reinforce UBSs, UPAs, and public or contracted hospitals. The selection is simplified; applicants must join the Health Department with standard documents. The 90-day calamity decree coincides with a COE Plan of Action (36 pages) addressing urban and Indigenous Reserve needs, including care-network reorganization, expanded diagnostics, standardized patient flows, and coordination with the DSEI-MS.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスがブラジルのチクングニア熱による全死亡の42%を占める
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱による死亡者が集中し、国内での有意な死亡率（20人中8人がドゥラードスで発生）、高い陽性率（64.9%）、医療システムの圧迫（ベッド占有率110%以上）が記録されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。地方自治体が公衆衛生上の大惨事と市民防衛緊急事態を宣言した深刻な状況であり、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: ドゥラードス市での死亡集中（42%）、先住民コミュニティへの大きな影響、医療システムの飽和状態（ベッド占有率110%超）が報告されている。保健省が公式パネルで報告した数値に基づく信頼性の高い情報。地域内での蚊媒介感染症の流行傾向を示唆しており、ベクター対策の重要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: بنسبة تنفيذ 99.5%.. تحصين 255 ألف رأس ماشية ضد الأمراض في كفر الشيخ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination of 255,000 head of cattle against diseases in Kafr El-Sheikh at a 99.5% implementation rate.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-25, in Kafr El-Sheikh Governorate, the national vaccination campaign against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) and lumpy skin disease (LSD) vaccinated 255,401 cattle, buffalo, and sheep, achieving 99.5% of targets. Coordinated by the Veterinary Directorate across all centers, towns, and villages, the effort was overseen by Dr. Fathy Abdel Aal. The governor urged continued follow-up, tagging, registration, and veterinary outreach, and asked breeders to follow preventive measures to sustain production. A FAO-assisted poultry breeders workshop was held in the Qelin and Kafr El-Sheikh centers under directives from the Minister of Agriculture, to strengthen protection of poultry. A free veterinary caravan in Qaraga village treated 645 animals and vaccinated 3,740 birds, with 381 internal medicine cases, 252 reproductive cases, and 12 surgeries, underscoring ongoing support for smallholders.

triage.headline_ja: カフル・シェイフ県における家畜疾病ワクチン接種キャンペーン、99.5%の実施率で25万5千頭が接種される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、疾病の流行や危機的状況ではなく、公衆衛生リスクは低い。対象国（CEPR監視対象）に該当する発生地もない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが「Inner Mongolia（中国）」を検出しているが、記事本文ではカフル・シェイフ県（エジプト）における牛疫・ランピー・スキン病のワクチン接種キャンペーンが主題である。中国への言及は見当たらない。記事は疾病発生ではなく、通常の予防キャンペーン報告であり、シグナルとしてピックアップする基準に合致しない。対象国リスト内での発生報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por la fiebre chikungunya: notificaron 268 nuevos casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya fever alert: 268 new cases reported.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya fever outbreak in Argentina continues to rise. The National Epidemiological Bulletin (BEN) reports 268 new chikungunya cases, bringing the total (confirmed and probable) to 837, with 746 autochthonous and 91 imported from Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Cuba. In epidemiological week 14 of 2026, 93% of cases are in the NOA region, led by Salta (494 cases: confirmed/probable), followed by Tucumán (144) and Jujuy (80). Other provinces show smaller clusters: Buenos Aires Province 28; Córdoba 14; CABA 7; with 2 in Entre Ríos and San Luis, and 1 in Santa Fe and Chaco. The ministry notes intensified SFAI surveillance and advises direct/confirmatory testing (qRT-PCR and ELISA NS1) within the first six days of fever to guide control measures. Vector is Aedes aegypti; risk to pregnant women includes vertical transmission.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱アラート：268例の新規患者を報告
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンで急速に拡大するチクングニア熱の流行であり、IHR基準3項目以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的な検査と管理課題）とWPRO基準3項目以上（重症度・妊婦への垂直感染リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染を媒介する蚊の存在、管理可能性の不確実性）に該当。社会的・政治的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はアルゼンチンでの流行を主題としているが、対象国リストにはアルゼンチンが含まれていないため、記事内で「ボリビア、ブラジル、パラグアイ、キューバから輸入」と言及されているブラジルのみを verified_locations に含める。チクングニアはWHO東南アジア地域（SEARO）および西太平洋地域（WPRO）での懸念が高い疾患であるが、本流行はアメリカ大陸である。ただしアルゼンチン国内での広範な急速伝播、妊婦への重篤なリスク（垂直感染）、Aedes aegypti媒介による高い流行性、国家レベルの対応強化（SFAI監視、検査指針）などから、シグナル基準として判定。

article.articleHeadline: По данным Всемирной организации здравоохранения, в 2024 году от малярии умерли 610 тысяч человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: According to the World Health Organization, in 2024, 610,000 people died from malaria.
article.articleSummary: According to the World Health Organization, 2024 recorded 282 million malaria cases and 610,000 malaria deaths worldwide. Malaria, caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes, is preventable and curable. Africa accounts for about 94% of infections: 2024 regional totals reached 265 million cases and 579,000 deaths, with children under five responsible for roughly 75% of regional fatalities. Nearly half of global cases occurred in Nigeria, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, Ethiopia, and Mozambique. Europe has had no malaria diagnoses since 2015. WHO urges use of insecticide-treated nets, prompt treatment, and vaccination in high-risk areas. Since 2019, vaccination campaigns have been funded by GAVI, the Global Fund, and Unitaid. In Oct 2023, WHO proposed a second vaccine, R21/Matrix-M, to complete RTS,S/AS01, with sufficient supply for at-risk children. Turkey eradicated local transmission; since 2010, only imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関によると、2024年にはマラリアで610,000人が死亡した
triage.triage_reason: 2024年の世界的なマラリア統計報告であり、新規の異常なイベント発生ではなく、定期的なWHO統計情報の報道。対象国内での新規流行や重大な危機的状況を示すシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2024年の既往統計情報（WHO年次報告）に基づく報道であり、新規シグナルではない。アフリカにおけるマラリアの風土病的状況を記述したもので、未知の流行や異常な発生増加を示していない。Turkeyはマラリア根絶国として記載されており、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: सुदूरपश्चिममा औलो सङ्क्रमण: निवारणको लक्ष्यप्राप्ति चुनौतीपूर्ण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Locust invasion in Sudurpashchim: Achieving the prevention target is challenging.
article.articleSummary: Locust invasion in Sudurpashchim Province, Nepal, has re-emerged with 387 confirmed outbreaks: 373 imported and 14 indigenous. Fifteen locally transmitted cases are reported across localities including Dadeldhura’s Ganapadhura GP-5, Parashuram Municipality-2; Baitadi’s Melouli Municipality-2; Pancheshwar GP-2; Kanchanpur’s Belauri Municipality-2; Kailali’s Kalari GP-2. District counts show Kailali 204, Kanchanpur 57, Achham 51, Doti 31, Bajura 22, Dadeldhura 12, Baitadi 8, and Darchula 2. The cross-border India risk is emphasized, with border districts driving vigilance. Separately, Nepal targets malaria elimination by 2030; WHO requires three consecutive years of zero locally transmitted malaria for an Elimination Certificate. Malaria cases comprise Plasmodium vivax 328, P. falciparum 54, P. ovale 3, and mixed infections 2, largely imported from Africa or returnees from India. Measures include enhanced surveillance, vector control, modern insecticide testing, bed nets, water management, and prompt fever testing. World Malaria Day 2026 theme: End malaria—our commitment.

triage.headline_ja: スドゥルパッチム地域のマラリア感染：排除目標の達成は困難
triage.triage_reason: ネパールにおいて387例の確認された局所流行が報告され、国境を越えたインド感染リスクが強調されている。WHOのマラリア排除認証には3年連続でゼロの地域伝播が必要とされており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスク（IHR基準2つ以上該当）が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーはネパール（対象国リストに未含）におけるマラリア流行を主に報じているが、「国境を越えたインドのリスク」が明確に強調されており、インドとの越境感染リスクが重要なコンテキスト。verified_locationsにはインドのみを含める。また、見出し翻訳に「Locust invasion（イナゴ侵入）」と記載されているが、記事内容はマラリア（Malaria）であり、翻訳の誤りの可能性あり。マラリアの局所伝播14例、373例の輸入例が報告されており、排除達成への課題が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Dia Mundial de Luta contra a Malária reforça prevenção e avanços no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Malaria Day Reinforces Prevention and Advances in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Brazil posted 2025 malaria figures at the lowest level since 1979, with a 15% annual decline, a 30% drop in Plasmodium falciparum infections, and a 28% reduction in deaths. On April 25, World Malaria Day, the Ministry of Health awarded Selos de Boas Práticas Rumo à Eliminação da Malária to Rondônia municipalities Porto Velho, Itapuã do Oeste, Cujubim, Guajará-Mirim, and Candeias do Jamari for surveillance progress. Rapid diagnostic tests have broadened access, especially in remote areas. Tafenoquine for Plasmodium vivax has been available since March 2024, with a pediatric formulation launched in March 2026, making Brazil the first country to offer it in the public system. Most cases remain in the Amazon region (Acre, Amapá, Amazonas, Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Pará, Rondônia, Roraima, Tocantins). Symptoms include fever, chills, headaches, and body pains; severe malaria can cause seizures, bleeding, respiratory distress, or shock. Transmission is via female Anopheles mosquitoes; prevention and care are provided free by SUS, emphasizing early diagnosis and vector-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア撲滅世界デーがブラジルにおける予防と進歩を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマラリア症例が1979年以来の最低水準に達し、15%の年間減少、30%のPlasmodium falciparum感染の低下、28%の死亡減少を報告している。この記事は世界マラリアデーを機にした肯定的な公衆衛生進歩の発表であり、危機的な感染症イベントではなく、むしろ感染症コントロールの成功事例である。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの世界マラリアデー（2026年4月25日）の発表であり、マラリア症例数の著しい減少と公衆衛生対策の成功を報告している。これはシグナルではなく、むしろ感染症対策の成功を示すポジティブなニュースである。危機的なアウトブレイクやシグナルの検出ではない。

article.articleHeadline: La Nación / Salud confirma la reaparición del serotipo 3 del dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Nación / Health confirms the reemergence of dengue serotype 3.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 April 2026, Paraguay confirms reemergence of dengue serotype DENV-3, detected in Asunción in a traveler returning from Brazil, increasing population susceptibility and risk of severe dengue. In weeks 13–15, 29 dengue cases were reported across Central (11), Asunción (14), Concepción (2), and Presidente Hayes (2); year-to-date dengue cases total 157. Two dengue hospitalizations (Villa Hayes and Villa Elisa) have recovered; no deaths reported in this period. The Limpio dengue outbreak continues to decline, with only one case in recent weeks. The overall situation is controlled, well below historic peaks, with an average of 363 weekly notifications, though nine regions show rising activity: Central, Itapúa, Canindeyú, Boquerón, Caazapá, Amambay, Guairá, and Caaguazú. Chikungunya totals reach 10 nationwide, including three imported from Bolivia; one case in Central in the past three weeks. Climate factors—frequent rains, humidity, high temperatures—favour mosquito breeding; continued vector control and early medical consultation are urged.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がデング熱セロタイプ3の再出現を確認
triage.triage_reason: パラグアイでデング熱セロタイプ3が再出現し、ブラジルからの帰国者から検出。複数部門で広がりを見せており、IHR基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク）を満たす。フルRRAの実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはパラグアイの複数の部門が列挙されているが、パラグアイは対象国リストに含まれていない。ブラジルからの帰国者がアスンシオンでセロタイプ3を検出したことが記事の主題であるため、ブラジルのみを verified_locations に含める。セロタイプ3の再出現と複数地域での広がりが懸念される。チクングニア症も同時発生中。

article.articleHeadline: انتكاسة صحية خطيرة .. عودة الإيدز للانتشار في زامبيا بعد تقليص الدعم الأمريكي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Serious health setback: AIDS is spreading again in Zambia after U.S. aid cuts.
article.articleSummary: As of April 25, 2026, Zambia confronts an uptick in HIV/AIDS cases in Mbungui, a town in northern Zambia, with infections rising from 1-2 per month to 28 in January, 28 in February, and 7 in March, totaling 63 cases. About half of patients in one ward were in advanced HIV stages; a 37-year-old man died within days of admission, and chest X-ray showed severe pulmonary TB, a common AIDS-related complication. U.S. aid programs, including the PEPFAR framework tied to the Trump administration's Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief, long funded treatment and prevention, but recent funding tweaks have sharply curtailed support, prompting a state of emergency to sustain medicines. Washington has set an end-April deadline for Zambia to sign a funding pact with conditions on access to U.S. mineral resources. Experts warn that continued funding cuts could collapse decades of AIDS control, pushing Zambia toward a renewed HIV/AIDS emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 深刻な健康危機：米国援助削減後、ザンビアでエイズが再び拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外の事態、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当。対象国ザンビアで検証済み。
triage.notes: ザンビア北部の町Mbunguiで月単位での感染症急増（1-2件/月→28件/月）、重度患者多数、死亡例あり。米国援助削減（PEPFAR関連）により治療・予防体制の崩壊リスク。複数国家間の政治的対立要素あり。

article.articleHeadline: Emergence and predominance of GII.17[P17] noroviruses in Brazil, 2023-2024 - Scientific Reports
article.articleSummary: Norovirus is a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis (AGE) worldwide. In Brazil (ten states) during 2023–2024, fecal samples from medically attended AGE patients were tested by RT-qPCR for Norovirus GI and GII, followed by sequencing of the ORF1/2 junction for genotyping. Norovirus prevalence was 22.5% over the two-year period, with GII genotypes comprising 85.6% of genotyped samples. Twenty-one genotypes were detected, including the emergence of GII.17[P17] in 2023 and its predominance in 2024. Median Ct values indicated higher viral load for GII.17 than GII.4 (Ct 20.9 vs 22.3, p=0.0493). GII.17 patients were older than GII.4 patients. This study provides the first South American evidence of GII.17[P17] replacing GII.4 Sydney[P16] as the dominant genotype in 2024, aligning with global dissemination.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるGII.17[P17]ノロウイルスの出現と優位性、2023-2024年
triage.triage_reason: ノロウイルスGII.17の新規優位遺伝子型の出現と地域的な置き換わりは疫学的に注目すべき事象だが、記事は学術報告であり現在の公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的な拡大リスクについて具体的情報がない。情報不足のため経過観察段階に留める。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にBrazilが記載されているが、記事サマリーは学術研究報告であり、現在の流行事象としてのブラジルでのノロウイルス発生を扱っていない。むしろ2023-2024年に採取された検体の遡及的遺伝子解析結果である。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性(新規遺伝子型の出現)、流行しやすさ(ヒト-ヒト感染)は明らかだが、現在の公衆衛生上の緊急度・重症度情報が不足しており、社会的・政治的関心の根拠も記事から読み取れない。フルRRA前段階の判定としては「WATCH」が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de MS mobiliza estrutura e amplia ações para conter avanço da chikungunya no Estado - OPINIÃO E NOTÍCIA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government of Mato Grosso do Sul mobilizes resources and expands actions to contain the spread of chikungunya in the state - Opinion and News
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-25, the Government of Mato Grosso do Sul intensified its integrated chikungunya response, focusing on Dourados, which accounts for the state’s highest caseload and deaths. The strategy encompasses patient care, surveillance, diagnosis, vector control, and interagency coordination across Dourados and Greater Dourados. In healthcare, 15 beds were opened at Hospital Regional de Dourados for chikungunya patients, with an emergency regulation flow to speed referrals. Epidemiological surveillance is reinforced through the State Situation Room (Sala de Situação) and the Emergency Operations Center (COE); Lacen-MS ensures timely laboratory confirmation. The response includes National SUS support, expanded vector-control activities in urban and indigenous areas, training for endemic agents (including Indigenous staff), and Army participation; Civil Defense logistics. A pilot vaccination strategy from the Ministry of Health targets Dourados and Itaporã. Public guidance stresses eliminating standing water, sealing water tanks, and seeking health care for high fever and joint pains.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソドスル州政府、州内のチクングニア熱の蔓延を封じ込めるため体制を動員し対応を拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・公衆衛生への深刻な影響）し、WPRO基準も複数該当（異常性、重症度、流行易性、対応困難性）。州レベルの政府動員と多部門連携による対応が実施されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ブラジル（マットグロッソドスル州）でのチクングニア熱の活発な流行。死亡例の報告、入院患者の急増、ベクター制御と予防接種パイロットプログラムの実施が記載されている。2026年4月時点での情報であり、州政府による統合的対応が既に展開中。

article.articleHeadline: 广西这些"小蚊虫"藏着疟疾传播风险 警惕输入性病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: These 'tiny mosquitoes' in Guangxi pose a risk of malaria transmission; be vigilant for imported malaria cases.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a risk in Guangxi, China, despite elimination status since 2013 and a 2019 national assessment. Anopheles mosquitoes capable of transmission are still widespread there, making importation and potential local transmission a persistent concern as cross-border labor, business, and study increase. Globally, malaria in 2024 totaled about 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths, with Africa and Southeast Asia bearing the heaviest burden; Guangxi's imported cases mainly originate from these regions. The two most dangerous malaria parasites are Plasmodium falciparum (malignant malaria) and Plasmodium vivax (tertian malaria), differing in severity and relapse. Symptoms include cyclic chills, fever, and heavy sweating; misdiagnosis or delayed treatment can progress to severe illness or death. The 19th National Malaria Day on April 26 promotes prevention, prevention of importation, and early detection and treatment, alongside personal protection and environmental sanitation to safeguard Guangxi's malaria-control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 広西に存在する「小さな蚊」が疟疾の伝播リスクをもたらしている 輸入症例の警戒が必要
triage.triage_reason: 中国広西での輸入性マラリア症例の継続的リスクを警告する記事だが、現在の実際の流行や多数の死亡・重症者の報告がなく、情報が限定的。スクリーニング基準は複数該当するが、詳細な疫学情報の不足により確実な判定が困難。
triage.notes: 記事は2013年の排除達成後も蚊媒介体が広西に広く存在し、国境を越えた労働・商取引・留学の増加に伴う輸入症例のリスクを警告している。ただし現在の患者数や死亡報告は明記されていない。4月26日の全国マラリア対策デー関連の啓発記事の性質が強い。WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、実際の現在の流行活動を示す具体的データに欠けるため、情報収集が必要な段階と判定。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात एक दशक में मलेरिया के मामलों में 92 प्रतिशत की गिरावट, पॉजिटिविटी रेट भी कम दर्ज | Mosquito.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gujarat records a 92 percent decline in malaria cases over a decade; positivity rate also recorded as low | Mosquito..
article.articleSummary: Gujarat reports a 92% drop in malaria cases over a decade, with 2025 malaria positivity per 1,000 population remaining below 1 across all districts and municipalities, moving from Category-2 to Category-1 under the Gujarat Malaria Elimination Framework. World Malaria Day (April 25) highlighted intensified surveillance and prevention: door-to-door fever checks, larvivorous fish in stagnant water, construction-site inspections, and free malaria testing and treatment at all government facilities. In 2025, over 181,000 fever patients were tested and treated if positive. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by infected female Anopheles mosquitoes breeding in clean, standing water. Symptoms include fever with chills, headache, body pains, nausea, and heavy sweating after the fever fades. Preventive measures stress early detection and complete treatment, with awareness campaigns in schools, media, and public spaces.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州、10年間でマラリア患者が92%減少、陽性率も低記録 | 蚊
triage.triage_reason: マラリア患者が大幅に減少し、陽性率が低下するという肯定的な公衆衛生成果を報告している。異常性、重症度の上昇、または国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア制御の成功事例であり、疾患発生の警告信号ではない。World Malaria Day (4月25日)に関連した啓発キャンペーンの文脈で報告されている。当該地域の対応能力は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Nagy a baj? Aggódnak a kutatók egy, a Covidhoz hasonló vírus miatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Big trouble? Researchers are worried about a COVID-19-like virus.
article.articleSummary: Lujo virus, also known as hemorrhagic fever, remains among the deadliest diseases with an estimated 80% case fatality. The virus, which spread from animals to humans like COVID-19, previously caused a single outbreak in Zambia and South Africa, killing 5 people before it was contained. Current reporting notes ongoing concern but not a looming outbreak. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids, limiting rapid spread through the general population. Regional authorities emphasize vigilant surveillance and precautions to prevent any new transmissions. The article highlights the severity and long disease course—victims can suffer up to two weeks before death—while suggesting that careful monitoring reduces the likelihood of widespread transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 大問題か？研究者がCOVID-19のようなウイルスについて懸念している
triage.triage_reason: Lujo出血熱は高い致死率（80%）を持つ重篤な疾患であり、動物から人間への感染の可能性があるため、スクリーニング基準で複数の項目に該当する。しかし、記事サマリーでは「進行中の懸念であるが、差し迫った流行ではない」と述べられており、現在のリスクレベルは不確定であるため、継続的な情報収集が必要である。
triage.notes: Lujo出血熱は過去にザンビアと南アフリカで5人の死亡者を出しているが、南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはザンビアのみ。記事は80%という高い致死率と動物由来感染の可能性を強調しており、監視体制が強化されていることが示唆される。現在は「進行中の懸念」段階であり、流行兆候は報告されていない。フルRRA実施時には、現在の感染状況、地域の防疫体制、国際的な情報共有状況の詳細を確認することが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Summer stomach infections: Why everyone has 'food poisoning' right now - The Times of India
article.articleSummary: As of 25 April 2026, summer stomach infections are prompting more visits to gastroenterology clinics, often labeled as 'food poisoning' but not always accurate, says Dr. Akash Chaudhary, CARE Hospitals, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Hot weather concentrates risk: bacteria multiply in warm conditions, delays between cooking and eating, improper refrigeration, and food left out can trigger symptoms (loose motions, nausea, cramps). Water is a common but underappreciated source—ice, beverages, washed produce, or warm storage of bottled water. Distinguish viral from bacterial causes: viral stomach infections spread through shared surfaces and close contact, leading to multiple household or workplace cases; bacterial illness centers on contaminated food/water. Dehydration and irregular meals worsen gut sensitivity in heat. Most episodes are mild and self-limiting after a few days with hydration; some cases require prompt care rather than waiting it out.

triage.headline_ja: 夏の胃腸感染症：なぜ今、みんなが「食中毒」にかかっているのか - インド・タイムス
triage.triage_reason: 季節的な胃腸感染症に関する医療情報記事。個別の集団発生イベント、異常な発症数、または公衆衛生上の緊急対応が必要な状況は示されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節的な健康情報記事であり、具体的な集団発生事例（アウトブレイク）、異常な発症者数の増加、または公衆衛生的懸念を示す実際のイベントを報告していない。医学的アドバイスと予防情報のための教育コンテンツと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Telangana: Experts call for innovation, collaboration to achieve malaria elimination by 2030
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day, Hyderabad hosted a symposium organized by Atal Incubation Centre-CCMB and Consytel Lifesciences to accelerate India's malaria elimination target for 2030. Participants from the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Centre for Study of Complex Malaria in India, Bharat Biotech, PHFI-Institute of Public Health Sciences, Gandhi Medical College, and CSIR-CCMB stressed inclusive healthcare access to reach all populations. India has cut malaria cases and exited the WHO HBHI group, but the last mile persists in tribal and forested regions amid evolving parasite biology and climate-driven shifts. Discussions covered Odisha's DAMaN programme, parasite relapse, diagnostic resistance, plant-based therapeutics, and vaccines. A panel, Now We Must: Closing India's Last Mile by 2030, urged stronger surveillance, cross-border cooperation, and AI-driven disease prediction. The consensus called for coordinated, evidence-based, inclusive investment and innovation to stay on track.

triage.headline_ja: テランガナ州：2030年のマラリア撲滅達成に向けて、革新と協力を呼びかける専門家ら
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア撲滅に向けた学術的シンポジウムの開催報告であり、新規の流行やアウトブレイクを示す具体的な事例ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）の報告ではなく、マラリア撲滅に向けた政策・研究シンポジウムの開催報告である。インドが過去にマラリア対策で成果を上げ、WHO HBHIグループを脱出したこと、および2030年の撲滅目標に向けた戦略議論が主題である。新規の疾病フラッシュ・重症化・急速な拡大の兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू से लड़ाई तेज करने को दिल्ली सरकार बनाएगी स्पेशल टास्क फोर्स
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Delhi government to form a special task force to speed up the fight against dengue.
article.articleSummary: Delhi government will form a Special Task Force, to be led by the MCD Commissioner, to accelerate fights against mosquito-borne diseases, notably dengue, ahead of the monsoon. The panel, bringing the health department, municipal corporations, and other Delhi government agencies together, will oversee citywide vector-control: identify breeding sites, ensure fogging, run cleaning drives, and raise public awareness. It will bolster surveillance and promptly address water-logging and garbage complaints, while improving inter-department coordination. The decision follows a Delhi High Court order of 24 December 2021 directing stronger preventive measures, penalties, accountability, and coordinated action against dengue, malaria, and chikungunya. Dengue cases in Delhi have fluctuated: 2020—1,072; 2021—9,613; 2022—4,469; 2023—9,266; 2024—6,391; by 29 March 2025, 98. Malaria: 2020—228; 2024—792; 23 by March 2025. Chikungunya: 2020—111; 2024—267; 4 by March 2025.

triage.headline_ja: デリー政府がデング熱との戦いを加速するための特別タスクフォースを設立
triage.triage_reason: デリーで蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・マラリア・チクングニア）の対策強化が政府レベルで進行中だが、現在の症例数は低水準であり、国際的拡大の懸念は明確でない。情報不足のため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 2025年3月29日現在のデング症例数は98と低水準だが、過去のデータ（2021年9,613件、2023年9,266件）では高い流行を経験している。デリーは蚊媒介感染症の流行地であり、モンスーン前の予防対策強化は定期的なコントロール活動。裁判所命令に基づく対策進行であり、危機的な新興状況ではない。今後の症例増加を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Travel warning over 'fatal' and 'high risk' virus in 42 countries - full list
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever, a mosquito-borne disease described as fatal and high-risk, prompted Travel Health Pro warnings backed by the UK Foreign Office for 42 countries across Africa, Central and South America, and Trinidad. In South/Central America, 2025 logged 346 confirmed cases and 143 deaths across seven countries; since early 2026, 41 cases and 18 deaths have been reported in Bolivia, Colombia, Peru and Venezuela. The 2024 Amazon region accounted for most cases, but spread has reached Sao Paulo State (Brazil) and Tolima Department (Colombia), with Venezuela areas previously not considered at risk. Colombia has endured an ongoing YF outbreak since mid-2024 (153 cases, 62 deaths). Urban outbreaks are a growing risk as jungle transmission nears cities. Vaccination is crucial, but COVID-19-era declines in YF vaccine uptake are noted. Incubation 3–6 days; symptoms include fever, muscle pain, jaundice; 15–25% progress to hemorrhagic fever with 20–50% mortality.

triage.headline_ja: 42カ国での「致命的」で「高リスク」なウイルスに関する渡航警告 - 完全リスト
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病の多国間流行で死亡例が報告されており、IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが該当。また対象国のブラジルで都市部への拡大が確認されており、シグナル識別の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはペルー・ボリビア・コロンビア・ベネズエラの4カ国での2026年初期の発症例を明記しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ。ブラジルはサンパウロ州への拡大が確認されている。アフリカも含まれるが対象国がないため除外。COVID-19との複合流行の可能性、ワクチン接種率低下、都市部への拡大リスク（アマゾン地域からサンパウロ州）が特に懸念される。出血熱への進行率15-25%、死亡率20-50%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: A bite in the night: Ghana's fragile gains in long fight against malaria
article.articleSummary: Bolgatanga, Upper East Region, Ghana, faces severe malaria as a three-year-old arrives at Bolgatanga Regional Hospital, later diagnosed as severe malaria and prompting questions about delay. World Malaria Report 2025 records 282 million cases and over 610,000 deaths in 2024, with Africa about 96% of the burden and children under five most affected. Rising resistance to antimalarials and insecticides, plus climate-driven mosquito expansion, threaten gains, with modeling projecting more than 120 million additional African cases and hundreds of thousands of deaths by 2050 if trends persist. Global financing remains well short of targets. Vaccines are rolling out in over 25 countries, and nets account for over 80% of distributed nets. Ghana's malaria prevalence fell from 27.5% (2011) to 8.6% (2022); deaths fell from 2,799 (2012) to 151 (2022) and 52 (2025). In 2025, Ghana logged 5.3 million malaria cases, under the National Malaria Elimination Strategic Plan (2024–2028) to disrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 夜の一刺し：ガーナのマラリア撲滅の長い戦いにおける脆弱な成果
triage.triage_reason: ガーナのマラリア状況は改善傾向にあり、急性的な公衆衛生危機を示す明確な証拠がない。しかし、薬剤耐性の上昇と気候変動による蚊の拡大という構造的脅威が指摘されており、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はガーナのマラリア状況。個別症例の遅延診断から始まり、世界的な脅威（薬剤耐性、気候変動）へと論述が展開している。ガーナの死亡数は大幅に削減されているが、2025年に530万症例が報告されており、構造的なリスク要因が残存している。WPRO基準で3項目該当するが、IHR基準では1項目のみのため、フルRRAのトリガーには至らない。引き続き監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात: एक दशक में मलेरिया के मामलों में 92 प्रतिशत की गिरावट, पॉजिटिविटी रेट भी कम दर्ज - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gujarat: 92 percent drop in malaria cases over a decade, positivity rate also recorded lower - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: Gujarat, India, reports a 92% reduction in malaria cases over the past decade, with malaria positivity rates under 1 per 1,000 population across all districts and municipalities, based on 2025 data released on World Malaria Day. The state health department attributes the decline to intensified surveillance and prevention under the Gujarat Malaria Eradication Framework, including door-to-door fever screening, larvivorous fish in stagnant water, construction site checks, blood testing for workers, and eliminating standing water around homes. Testing and treatment at all government health facilities remain free. In 2025, over 181,000 fever cases were tested and those positive were promptly treated. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by infected female Anopheles mosquitoes that breed in clean stagnant water. Symptoms include fever with chills, headache, body pains, nausea or vomiting, and heavy sweating after fever subsides. Public awareness campaigns via exhibitions, rallies, schools, social media, TV and radio support prevention.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州：過去10年間でマラリア症例が92%減少、陽性率も低水準を記録
triage.triage_reason: マラリア症例の顕著な減少を報告する好ましいニュースであり、新規の感染症危機や異常事象ではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア制御の成功事例を報告するもので、感染症危機や緊急事象ではない。グジャラート州で過去10年間に92%の症例減少、陽性率が人口1,000人当たり1未満という改善状況が述べられており、公衆衛生上のポジティブな進展である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Paludisme : 47 pays déclarés exempts de la maladie selon le rappor...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria: 47 countries declared malaria-free according to the report.
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day, April 25, 2026, reports a mixed global malaria picture by the WHO. Forty-seven countries are now malaria-free, and the Mekong basin has seen a 90% drop in cases. Since 2000, international efforts have prevented about 14 million malaria deaths. The campaign theme emphasizes resolve: 'Determined to eliminate malaria—now that we can, it’s our duty to achieve it.' Despite gains, the overall trajectory remains stagnant; in 2024, global malaria reached 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths, with a slight increase from the previous year. Alarm grows over confirmed artemisinin resistance across four African countries: Eritrea, Uganda, Tanzania, and Rwanda. Financially, 2024 funding totaled $3.9 billion, less than half of the $9.3 billion target for 2025, risking undoing progress.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア：WHOの報告書によると47カ国がマラリア撲滅を宣言
triage.triage_reason: アルテミシニン耐性確認による懸念が存在するが、記事の主要メッセージはWHOの年次報告であり、現在進行中の具体的な危機イベントではない。対象国での耐性確認は重要だが、詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO世界マラリアデー2026年報告書の概要であり、肯定的な進展（47カ国撲滅達成、メコン盆地での90%削減）と懸念事項（アルテミシニン耐性確認4カ国：エリトリア、ウガンダ、タンザニア、ルワンダ；資金不足）の混在を報告。対象国ではタイがメコン盆地での進展の文脈で言及され、ウガンダ、タンザニア、ルワンダがアルテミシニン耐性確認国として列挙されている。ただし、これらは耐性の確認報告であり、現在進行中の具体的な流行拡大イベントとは言い難い。記事は2026年時点での全般的な状況評価であり、リアルタイム危機というより年次報告の性質が強い。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Internações por gripe crescem 92,9% e mortes avançam 10% em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: Influenza hospitalizations rise 92.9% and deaths rise 10% in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Influenza hospitalizations in Brazil rose 92.9% and deaths 10% through April 18, 2026, compared with the same period in 2025. The Ministry of Health reports 4,658 influenza-related hospitalizations and 259 deaths in the first four and a half months of 2026. In the prior year, 2,414 hospitalizations and 259 deaths occurred in the same window, indicating a notable rise in severe cases while mortality remained steady. One fatality involved a 13-year-old boy in Sorocaba, interior São Paulo state, who died from flu complications and had no reported comorbidities. Vaccination, extended last year to all residents over six months, was not received by the boy. The report underscores the importance of influenza vaccination and public health measures to mitigate severe outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年にインフルエンザ入院患者が92.9%増加、死亡者数は10%増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおいてインフルエンザ入院患者が前年同期比92.9%の大幅増加を示しており、IHR基準における深刻な公衆衛生への影響および異常性が認められるため、フルリスク評価への進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年の将来シナリオを描いているが、シグナルトリアージ対象として扱う。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれる。入院患者数の顕著な増加が報告されており、ワクチン未接種による重症例（小児死亡例を含む）が記録されている。国内的には公式統計が発表されている形跡があり、政府機関（厚生労働省）の関心は確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: World Malaria Day observed across Nagaland
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day on 25 April 2026 was observed across Nagaland’s districts Mon, Longleng, Peren, Phek, Noklak and Wokha. Mon district reported the first imported P. vivax from Longwa in October 2025; indigenous cases rose to 77 by December 2025, with 20 more cases detected January–April 2026 and most patients recovered, though the district is not yet malaria-free. Injectable artesunate is now available free of cost to prevent deaths; authorities urged elimination of mosquito breeding sites and introduction of larvivorous fish amid coexisting dengue and Japanese Encephalitis. In Longleng, Peren, Phek, Noklak and Wokha, NVBDCP and district officers led awareness, fever screening, LLIN usage, door-to-door campaigns, and surveillance aimed at elimination by 2030 (Phek) and indigenous-case targets by 2027, with emphasis on rapid tests, antimalarial drugs, strengthened real-time reporting and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: World Malaria Day observed across Nagaland（ナガランド州全域でマラリア撲滅の日を観察）
triage.triage_reason: マラリア、デング熱、日本脳炎の複合的流行が報告されており、スクリーニング基準1つ以上に該当するが、記事は啓発活動・公衆衛生キャンペーン報道であり、急速な流行拡大や新規の深刻な感染症イベントの証拠に乏しい。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Mon地区ではP. vivax（三日熱マラリア）の輸入症例が2025年10月に報告され、2025年12月までに77例の土着症例が確認されている。複数の感染症（マラリア、デング熱、日本脳炎）が共存しており、蚊媒介感染症の長期曝露リスクと流行性が認められる。ただし記事の焦点は公式な啓発キャンペーン・意識向上活動報道であり、急速な感染症有事の証拠は乏しい。2026年4月時点で患者の大多数が回復しており、現時点での重症度は低い。フルRRAではなく、今後の流行動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: No Dia Mundial de Luta contra a Malária, Acre registra maior redução de casos da Amazônia Legal e reforça compromisso com a vida
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Malaria Day: Acre records the largest reduction in cases in the Legal Amazon and reinforces its commitment to life.
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day, April 25, 2026, Acre, Brazil, reports a 65.4% first‑quarter reduction in malaria cases, to 432 from 1,249 in Q1 2025, continuing a downward trend after a 38.9% drop in 2025—the largest among the Legal Amazon states. The progress stems from integrated strategies by the state health secretariat (Sesacre) including strengthened epidemiological surveillance, expanded testing in strategic areas, and decentralization of care to speed diagnosis and treatment, aiming to interrupt transmission and prevent hospitalizations. State Malaria Control Program head Júnior Mota Pinheiro cites ongoing training, active case monitoring, and timely diagnosis as pivotal. Preventive measures emphasize bed nets, repellents, protective clothing, and screens on doors and windows. Health officials, including Secretary José Bestene and Governor Mailza Assis, stress sustaining these actions to protect lives in the malaria-endemic Amazon region. The fight remains a persistent public health priority.

article.articleHeadline: Chủ động kiểm soát nhiễm khuẩn trong mùa bão lũ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proactive Control of Bacterial Infections During the Flood Season
article.articleSummary: Post-flood conditions in Vietnam raise bacterial and viral infection risks. At Bach Mai Hospital in Hanoi, Dr. Truong Anh Thu urges proactive infection control and safe water/food hygiene to prevent outbreaks. Floodwaters, debris, animal carcasses, and blocked drains create environments conducive to pathogens. Common post-disaster diseases include respiratory infections (pneumonia, influenza, COVID-19); diarrheal diseases (hepatitis A/E, cholera, typhoid); skin infections and tetanus from contaminated water or mud; and vector-borne diseases such as dengue, malaria, and leptospirosis from mosquitoes and rodents. Fungal infections and food contamination can arise within 48 hours when storage is disrupted. Hospitals should screen on arrival, isolate suspected cases, use PPE, and vaccinate (tetanus) as needed. Public guidance includes boiling water 1 minute or using unscented 5.25% sodium hypochlorite at 1/8 teaspoon per 3.8 L; wait 48 hours before testing water for coliform/E. coli; emphasize hand hygiene, surface disinfection (0.1–0.5% chlorine).

triage.notes: 記事はハノイの医師による洪水後の感染症リスクに関する警告・予防措置ガイダンスである。複数の感染症（コレラ、A型肝炎、チフス、デング、マラリア、レプトスピラ症など）のリスク要因が列挙されており、WPRO基準（異常性、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の懸念）で複数該当。しかし、実際の患者発生数、死亡数、確認病例の有無が記載されていないため、予警的・教育的性質の記事と評価される。今後、洪水地域での実際の病例報告が出現した場合はPICKUPに昇格すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat Sees 92 Pc Fall In Malaria Cases Over Decade, Records Low Positivity Rate | Nation
article.articleSummary: Gujarat, India, reports a 92% drop in malaria cases over the last decade, with malaria positivity below 1 per 1,000 across all districts and municipal corporations and advancement from Category-2 to Category-1 under the elimination framework. In 2025, over 181,000 fever patients were tested and positive cases treated promptly. The decline follows widespread measures: house-to-house and fever surveillance, anti-larval operations, construction-site inspections, blood screening of labourers, and introduction of larvivorous fish in stagnant water. Diagnosis and treatment are free at government centres. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium and transmitted by infected female Anopheles mosquitoes that breed in clean or stagnant water; symptoms include chills, fever with shivering, headache, body aches, nausea, and sweating after fever subsides. Public awareness campaigns—exhibitions, rallies, schools, and media—support preventive practices ahead of World Malaria Day 2026, theme 'Driven to End Malaria: Now We Can. Now We Must.'

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया से बचाव के लिए जागरूक होना बेहद जरूरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Awareness for malaria prevention is extremely important.
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day, April 25, 2026, awareness programs were held across Aurangabad to educate the public about malaria prevention. District Vector Borne Diseases Control Officer Dr. Sunil Kumar and district malaria office staff spoke at Aurangabad Sadar Hospital, with hospital administrators and health workers (ANMs/GNMs) participating. The sessions explained that malaria is transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes and that Plasmodium vivax and Plasmodium falciparum are the two malaria parasites reported in India. Symptoms include chills, rigors, headache, vomiting, dizziness, and high fever with sweating, occurring in cycles. Free treatment is available at government hospitals and health centers. Preventive measures urged include eliminating standing water in pits, drains, containers, water tanks, pots, tires, and adding a few drops of kerosene to stagnant water; use mosquito nets at night. Additional programs were held at Dev Mod private nursing college, Baratpur’s Rajya Sanskrit Primary School, and Barun block.

article.articleHeadline: Hasonlóan terjed, mint a Covid, de 13 nap alatt öl: Halálos vírus miatt kongatják a vészharangot a szakértők
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spreads like COVID, but kills in 13 days: Experts sound the alarm over a deadly virus.
article.articleSummary: Lujo virus, one of the deadliest pathogens, causes an estimated 80% case-fatality. Identified in 2008 in Zambia (Lusaka) and South Africa (Johannesburg), its name derives from these cities. The first documented victim, a Zambian travel organizer, began with mild symptoms that rapidly deteriorated and died on day 13 after onset. Five people were infected in that outbreak, including healthcare workers. Lujo belongs to the Arenaviridae family and is typically rodent-borne, entering cells via the human neuropilin-2 receptor. Symptoms typically appear within two weeks post-infection and quickly worsen. The virus is zoonotic, like COVID-19, but no new outbreaks have been recorded since 2008. Experts warn it persists in wildlife, and outbreaks in densely populated areas or weak health systems could have severe, unpredictable consequences as of 2026-04-25.

triage.headline_ja: COVIDのように広がるが13日で致死：専門家が致命的ウイルスについて警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: Lujoウイルスは高い致死率（80%）を持つ新興病原体だが、2008年以降新たな集団発生は報告されていない。歴史的イベントの文脈的警告であり、現在の積極的流行を示唆する具体的証拠がない。情報が限定的なため要経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は2008年のZambiaおよびSouth Africaで同定されたLujoウイルスについて述べている。South AfricaはWPRO対象国でないため除外。2008年以降新規集団発生の報告がなく、専門家による将来のリスク警告が主要内容。ウイルスが野生動物に存在し、密集地域での発生の可能性があることは懸念されるが、現在の活発な流行を示す直接的証拠は記事に含まれていない。IHR基準は3項目該当するが、現在の具体的脅威状況が不明であるためWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra menor número de casos de malária desde 1979 em 2025 - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records its lowest malaria case count since 1979 in 2025.
article.articleSummary: Brazil in 2025 posted its lowest malaria case count since 1979, down 15% from 2024; Plasmodium falciparum infections fell 30% and malaria deaths declined 28%. Released on World Malaria Day (25 April) during ExpoEpi, the data reflect stronger prevention, timely diagnosis, and treatment, plus recognition of health workers and communities. The Ministry granted the 'Selo de Boas Práticas Rumo à Eliminação da Malária' to Rondônia municipalities: Porto Velho, Itapuã do Oeste, Cujubim, Guajará-Mirim, and Candeias do Jamari. Measures include broader rapid diagnostic testing in remote areas and continued tafenoquine use for Plasmodium vivax since March 2024, with a pediatric formulation launching March 2026, prioritizing Indigenous populations; Brazil is the first to offer tafenoquine in SUS. Malaria remains concentrated in the Amazon region across Acre, Amapá, Amazonas, Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Pará, Rondônia, Roraima, and Tocantins.

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात: एक दशक में मलेरिया के मामलों में 92 प्रतिशत की गिरावट, पॉजिटिविटी रेट भी कम दर्ज

On World Malaria Day, authorities highlighted sustained surveillance and prevention; 2025 testing covered over 181,000 fever patients, with positives treated promptly. Under the Gujarat Malaria Elimination Framework, districts advanced from Category-2 to Category-1. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by infected female Anopheles mosquitoes that breed in clean, standing water. Symptoms include chills with fever, headaches, body aches, nausea/vomiting, and heavy sweating after fever subsides. article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Malaria Day Awareness Seminar in Mathura Health Department | Mathura News: Awareness Seminar Held in Mathura on World Malaria Day
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day, 25 April 2026, Mathura's health department held an awareness seminar at the Chief Medical Officer's Office. Attendees included CMO Dr. Radhavallabh, Additional CMO Dr. Alok Kumar, VB D in-charge Dr. Anuj Chaudhary, District Malaria Officer Dr. Gopal Garg, District Health Education Officer Jitendra Singh, and malaria department staff. The district malaria officer elaborated on the day’s importance, mosquito-borne diseases, and their prevention and treatment. The CMO urged staff to implement the microplan in their zones, and all participants took a malaria prevention pledge. Public guidance emphasized mosquito avoidance: cover water containers and tanks, empty and clean weekly; where drainage is not possible, add kerosene or burnt motor oil to deter breeding; sleep under nets, apply repellents, and wear full-body clothing. Fever warrants prompt testing at a health facility with complete prescribed treatment; avoid quack doctors, aspirin or ibuprofen for high fever, and never take medicines on an empty stomach.

article.articleHeadline: Acre registra queda histórica de 65,4% nos casos de malária em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre records a historic 65.4% drop in malaria cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Acre, Brazil, on World Malaria Day (April 25, 2026), reports a 65.4% drop in malaria cases in the first quarter: 432 cases January–March 2026 versus 1,249 in the same period 2025. This continues a downward trend that began in 2025, when Acre achieved a 38.9% reduction and led the states of Amazônia Legal in malaria control. Officials attribute the improvement to intensified epidemiological surveillance, early diagnosis, and rapid treatment, especially in vulnerable Amazon regions. The Amazônia Legal region historically accounts for the majority of malaria in Brazil due to climate and environmental conditions favorable to Anopheles mosquitoes. The gains reflect ongoing public health measures to reduce transmission and prevent outbreaks in high-risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州、2026年のマラリア患者数が65.4%減少という歴史的低下を記録
triage.triage_reason: マラリア患者数の継続的な減少を報告する肯定的なニュースであり、異常性、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、または渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: この記事はマラリア制御の成功例を報告するもので、ピックアップの対象とはならない。患者数の減少傾向は公衆衛生上の改善を示す肯定的な指標であり、危機管理のシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dia Mundial da Malária: FVS-RCP intensifica ações permanentes de prevenção e controle no Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Malaria Day: FVS-RCP intensifies permanent prevention and control measures in Amazonas.
article.articleSummary: Active malaria prevention and control measures are intensified across Amazonas, Brazil, in conjunction with World Malaria Day. The Fundação de Vigilância em Saúde do Amazonas – Dra. Rosemary Costa Pinto (FVS-RCP) emphasizes year-round actions that strengthen health surveillance, including active case finding, expanded diagnosis, timely treatment, professional training, and distribution of supplies, with a focus on interior areas most vulnerable. New measures introduce additional medications, expand testing of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) activity to enable safe tafenoquine administration, and create epidemiological monitoring “situation rooms.” The program prioritizes the Distrito Sanitário Especial Indígena (DSEI) of Amazonas and coordination with priority municipalities. Mass distribution of long-lasting insecticide-treated nets and other antimalarials continues, reinforcing malaria response across the state.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア世界デー：FVS-RCPがアマゾナス州での予防・管理活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるマラリア予防・管理キャンペーンの報道であり、新規の流行発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。既知の風土病地域での定期的な対策強化を描写しているため、緊急的なシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのアマゾナス州における予防・管理活動の強化を報じているが、対象国リストに含まれていない。ブラジルは対象国（WPRO地域外）のため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。
