article.articleHeadline: Casos de gripe disparam e reforçam alerta para vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu cases surge, underscoring the call for vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports 4,181 influenza-associated Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases and 259 deaths through April 17, 2026, with Influenza A(H3N2) as the dominant strain and regional detection of the subclade K (J.2.4.1). Fiocruz cautions the surge may persist in about 14 of 27 states. A December PAHO alert warned of an earlier, more intense season. The National Immunization Program offers the influenza vaccine year-round for children 6 months–<6 years, pregnant people, and those aged 60+, with campaigns underway in Centro-Oeste, Nordeste, Sudeste and Sul; 2025 regional coverage was 41.1% in the North and 54.15% elsewhere (goal 90%). Misinformation and access barriers impair uptake, but vaccines reduce hospitalizations, ICU care, deaths, and pneumonia. The article encourages vaccination, including private-sector access, to protect individuals and communities.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ患者数が急増し、予防接種の必要性を改めて警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでインフルエンザA(H3N2)による4,181件のSRAG症例と259人の死亡が報告されており、重症度基準に該当する可能性がある。ただし、記事は公衆衛生対応（ワクチン接種キャンペーン）に焦点を当てた啓発記事であり、制御不可能な危機的状況を示唆する情報が不足しているため、追加情報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: IHR基準は1つのみ該当だが、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度（259人の死亡、4,181件の入院ケース）、継続的曝露（14の州で引き続き流行の可能性）、流行易易性（H3N2のヒト-ヒト感染）に該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。ただし記事は予防対策の有効性と接種キャンペーンの進行状況に焦点を当てており、制御不能性の証拠は限定的。アウトブレイク規模と管理可能性の詳細情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Health Update | Vaccination Gains Advance in Africa; Antimalarial Resistance Threatens Progress
article.articleSummary: Vaccination gains across Africa are tempered by outbreaks and resistance. HPV vaccination expanded to 35 countries since 2019, with 47% coverage in 2024 and nearly 1 million cervical cancer deaths averted across 29 countries; funding gaps of about 30% threaten continued progress, potentially costing up to 600,000 lives by 2030 and undermining a $1.8 billion economic benefit. A polio-focused campaign across Angola, Namibia and the Democratic Republic of Congo vaccinated over 10 million children in March 2026 to curb cross-border spread; Angola has 39 cases since 2025, while DRC shows distinct variants and Namibia reports >90% coverage. In eastern Chad, Measles and Meningitis outbreaks in Adré coincide with refugee influx from Sudan (≈1.3 million refugees; ~926,000 in the east); >1,500 admissions since Jan 2026; meningitis cases rising to 212 (Mar–Apr) with 25 deaths (CFR ~12%), while measles cases exceed 370 in March. Emergency campaigns reached 95,500 measles and 337,800 meningitis vaccinations in Adré; regional spread remains a concern. Separately, artemisinin resistance to malaria is spreading to Rwanda, Uganda, Eritrea and Tanzania, risking treatment failure and up to 500 million additional cases with >$1 billion in losses if action is delayed. The 2024 malaria death toll reached 610,000, 95% in Africa, underscoring the urgency of diversifying therapies and reinforcing prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 週間保健ニュース | アフリカにおけるワクチン接種の進展、抗マラリア薬耐性が進行の脅威に
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤な感染症（麻疹、髄膜炎、ポリオ、マラリア）が対象国（DRC、チャド隣接）で同時発生・拡大しており、IHR基準3項目以上該当。国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響が明確。
triage.notes: 記事ではチャド（Adré）での麻疹・髄膜炎アウトブレイク、スーダンからの難民流入（130万人）、ポリオキャンペーン（アンゴラ、ナミビア、DRC）、マラリア耐性（ルワンダ、ウガンダ、タンザニア）が報告されている。対象国のうちDRCのみが検証対象。チャドはアフリカ地域対象国外のため検証地に含めていない。複数疾患の複合的な脅威、難民流動による国際拡大リスク、高い死亡率（髄膜炎CFR~12%）、耐性菌の拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai civic body rolls out comprehensive anti-malaria strategy
article.articleSummary: Malaria control drive in Mumbai aims to render the city malaria-free ahead of the monsoon. A Rapid Response Action Committee coordinates preventive measures across departments, prioritizing elimination of mosquito breeding sites and a 'Zero Mosquito Breeding Campaign' around municipal hospitals and health centers, including Hindu Hriday Samrat Balasaheb Thackeray dispensaries. Pre-monsoon preparedness encompasses specialised training for public health staff, private clinicians, safety officers, and construction-site workers, with private hospitals urged to aid in early diagnosis and complete treatment. Municipal Health Committee Chairman Harish BhandARGE said activities are conducted with assistant commissioners, medical officers, and pest control officers. Citizens with fever are urged to seek prompt medical care. The 'Aarogya Saathi' program spans 4,075 construction sites, aiming to train 20,000–30,000 workers; 1,622 have been trained at 123 sites. Awareness drives will target schools, colleges, and both government and private establishments.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ市民団体がマラリア対策の包括的戦略を展開
triage.triage_reason: インドのムンバイにおけるマラリア制御の予防的・対策的活動を報じる記事。異常事態や重症度の急増を示す具体的情報が欠けており、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はムンバイでのマラリア制御キャンペーンの開始を報じており、症例数の増加や疫学的異常を示す具体的データが記載されていない。モンスーン季節前の予防的施策であるため、異常・予想外性は低い。ただし、長期的な曝露リスク（モンスーン期）と流行しやすさの条件が存在するため、WPRO基準で2項目該当。社会的・政府関心は存在するが、IHR基準を満たさないため本格的なリスク評価は不要と判断。続報が必要な場合は症例数増加やアウトブレイクの兆候を注視すること。

article.articleHeadline: Copa do Mundo acende alerta para risco de aumento nos casos de Sarampo | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup raises alarm over the risk of an increase in measles cases | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: As of 25 April 2026, measles poses renewed concern ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico (June 11–July 19). Brazil has issued an alert over possible reintroduction of measles after the tournament via traveling visitors, given outbreaks in the three host countries. Brazil remains endemic-free for measles since 2024. In the Americas last year, 14,891 measles cases were reported across 14 countries with 29 deaths; by March 5, 2026, 7,145 infections had been confirmed this year. PAHO notes rising measles activity across the region, emphasizing vaccination access over supply. Public health guidance urges travelers to receive the MMR vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella) with at least 15 days before departure, and to monitor for fever and a spreading red rash upon return, seeking care if symptoms appear. Measles spreads mainly by airborne droplets and is highly contagious.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップがはしかの症例増加リスクに警告を発する | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国でのはしか流行と国際的なイベント（2026年ワールドカップ）を通じた拡大リスク、および複数対象国での確認を認める。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはワールドカップ開催国（米国、カナダ、メキシコ）でのはしか流行とブラジルへの再導入リスクを主題としている。米国、カナダ、メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため、実際の感染発生地の verified_locations はブラジルのみ。しかしIHR基準では国際的な拡大リスク（他国での流行が報告されている）と、渡航を通じた拡大懸念が明確に該当する。PAHO（汎米保健機関）が地域的な上昇傾向を指摘しており、公衆衛生上の関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Doctor explains: When a fever is not 'just viral' and how to spot malaria early
article.articleSummary: Malaria in India is intensified by monsoon conditions, per Dr. Goma Bali Bajaj. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes and often begins like a viral fever; however, high-grade fever with cyclical chills/sweating persisting 2–3 days during or after the monsoon warrants early testing. Diagnosis relies on Rapid Diagnostic Tests and peripheral blood smear, with confirmation of Plasmodium falciparum versus vivax essential since falciparum can be severe and vivax may relapse. Uncomplicated malaria is treated with Artemisinin-based Combination Therapy; vivax requires additional treatment to prevent relapse, while severe malaria requires intravenous antimalarials (e.g., artesunate) and possible ICU care for features such as altered consciousness, severe anemia, respiratory distress, organ dysfunction, or persistent vomiting. Children and the elderly are at higher risk; warning signs include persistent fever, confusion, vomiting, reduced urine output, and breathlessness. Climate change may extend transmission beyond traditional seasons. India targets malaria elimination by 2030 but faces remote-area challenges; prevention emphasizes nets, repellents, avoiding standing water, protective clothing, and strengthened surveillance and diagnostics access.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が説明：熱がただのウイルス性でない場合と、マラリアを早期に発見する方法
triage.triage_reason: インドのマラリア（ファルシパルム）に関する医学的説明記事。モンスーン季に感染リスク増加が述べられているが、新規の流行報告や異常発生の報告ではなく、診断・治療に関する啓発記事であるため、現在の流行状況の詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのマラリア診断・治療に関する医学的な啓発記事。モンスーン季の感染増加やマラリア除去目標（2030年）が言及されているが、現在の具体的な流行規模、患者数、死亡者数などの統計情報がない。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（ファルシパルム型の重症化リスク）、長期曝露（モンスーン季の継続的な感染リスク）、流行しやすさ（蚊媒介感染の特性）で3項目該当するが、これはマラリアの一般的特性であり、新規の異常発生を示す証拠ではない。続報や流行統計の更新を注視する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: ये है नेगेटिव जिला: यहां चार माह में मलेरिया की 67 हजार से अधिक जांच, मच्छर वाले बुखार पर लोग एहतियातों से लगा रहे लगाम | Ye Hai Negetiv Jila Yhan Char Mah Men Mleriya Ki 67 Hjar Se Adhik Janch Mchchhr Vale Bukhar Pr Log Ehtiyaton Se Lga Rhe Lgam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This is the Negative District: Here, in four months, more than 67,000 malaria tests; people are taking precautions to curb mosquito-borne fever.
article.articleSummary: Malaria tests in Karauli district, Rajasthan, India show zero locally detected infections as of 25 April 2026. From January 1 to April 21, 67,558 blood samples were tested, with 49,986 slides and 17,572 rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs); no malaria case was positive. The district uses rapid tests that yield results in about two minutes, with all positive RDTs subsequently confirmed by blood-slide microscopy, which remains the standard diagnostic method. Community awareness campaigns—led by Anganwadi workers and female health workers—have improved preventive practices, including eliminating standing water around homes, regularly draining coolers and water tanks, using bed nets at night, wearing covered clothing, and applying mosquito-repellent creams. Fever patients are advised to promptly seek care at local health centers. Data are reported by blocks such as Hindaun City and Karauli, with all blocks showing zero infections to date, indicating sustained malaria control.

triage.headline_ja: これはネガティブ地区です：ここでは4ヶ月間に67,000以上のマラリア検査が実施されており、人々は蚊媒介熱を抑制するために予防措置をとっています
triage.triage_reason: インドのラジャスタン州カラウリ地区でマラリアの集団検査が実施されているが、検出される実際の陽性症例がなく、むしろ地域の感染制御成功を示す記事である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準において懸念事項が認識されず、公衆衛生危機を示唆していない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア感染がゼロであることを強調しており、むしろ地域の感染制御施策の成功を報告している。検査数が多いことは監視活動の強化を示すが、実際の患者発生がないため、シグナルとしてのリスクは認識されない。

article.articleHeadline: जागरुकता से ही मलेरिया रोग से बचाव संभव: डॉ चौधरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria prevention is possible only through awareness: Dr. Chaudhary.
article.articleSummary: Malaria awareness rally organized in Simdega on World Malaria Day, led by Dr. Yogendra Chaudhary of Sadar Hospital. The event started at Sadar Hospital, moved through Jhulan Singh Chowk, Mahavir Chowk, and Neeche Bazaar Petrol Pump, then returned to the hospital. Officials stressed malaria prevention measures, including using mosquito nets and getting a blood test for fever promptly. They also urged indoor spraying of DDT and completing treatment if malaria is diagnosed. The public health initiative underscores ongoing education and prevention efforts for malaria in Simdega, India, on World Malaria Day, with no specific outbreak or case counts reported in the coverage.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア予防は認識を通じてのみ可能である：チャウダリー博士
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はシムデガ（インド・ジャールカンド州）での世界マラリアデー啓発行進の報道であり、具体的な患者発生、アウトブレイク、または公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告していない。予防啓発活動のみが記述されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は定期的な啓発活動であり、患者発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。マラリアは既知の風土病であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 景区的鹦鹉套圈是怎么把人送进ICU的？警惕正逐年攀升的"鹦鹉热"！_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How does the parrot-ring-toss at tourist attractions send people to the ICU? Beware the year-by-year rise of psittacosis (parrot fever)!
article.articleSummary: Psittacosis (Chlamydia psittaci), a zoonotic respiratory infection, is rising in China since 2023, with southern regions most affected. In Beijing, a man won a parrot at a tourist fair; the bird later died, and his father developed high fever and rapid respiratory deterioration, requiring ICU care and tracheostomy. Chest imaging showed severe bilateral pulmonary consolidation (ARDS). The diagnosis was severe pneumonia with respiratory failure due to psittacosis. National data show increasing psittacosis hospitalizations (about 6,000 psittacosis-positive inpatients from 2022–2024, per Lancet Microbe 2025), with southern China more impacted; Europe also reports upticks (Austria, Denmark, Germany, Sweden, Netherlands). Transmission is mainly via inhalation of dust from infected birds’ droppings, feathers, and secretions; human-to-human spread is rare. Prevention emphasizes avoiding live-animal games, purchasing from reputable shops with clean birds, and routine disinfection (70% alcohol, 1% Lysol, or 10% bleach). Early treatment yields rapid improvement.

triage.headline_ja: 観光地のオウム輪投げはどのようにして人をICUに送るのか？年々上昇している「オウム熱」に警戒！
triage.triage_reason: オウム熱（オウム病）は中国で2023年以降上昇傾向にあり、重症度（ARDS、ICU入院、気管切開）と異常性（年間上昇傾向）を満たす。また欧州での増加も報告されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事はオウム病（Chlamydia psittaci）の上昇について報道しており、中国南部を中心に2023年以来増加、2022～2024年で約6,000件の入院例あり。欧州（オーストリア、デンマーク、ドイツ、スウェーデン、オランダ）での増加も報告されているが、記事の主題は中国でのイベント。ヒト-ヒト感染は稀だが、鳥類との接触（観光地での野生動物との交流など）による曝露リスクが継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: Opas convocar países para reforçar vacinação - 25/04/2026 - Equilíbrio e Saúde - Folha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: PAHO calls on countries to bolster vaccination
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks across the Americas prompt PAHO to urge intensified vaccination as the Vaccination Week in the Americas runs April 25–May 2. In 2025, 14,767 measles cases were confirmed in 13 countries, about 32 times 2024. By April 5, 2026, more than 15,300 cases had been reported, higher than 2025. The region lost endemic transmission-free status in November 2025; Brazil remains recertified since 2024, but cross-border movement and nearby outbreaks sustain importations. As of April 6, 2026, Brazil reported two imported cases (São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro). Measles is airborne; symptoms include high fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and a rash 7–14 days after exposure. The goal is 95% immunity with two doses: first at 12 months (MMR) and second at 15 months (tetra-viral including varicella). Coverage up to March 1: 91.12% first dose, 77.46% second dose.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：PAHOが予防接種の強化を呼び掛け
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の多地域流行でPAHOが緊急呼び掛け。IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。対象国ブラジルで確認された輸入症例により即座のフルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はアメリカ大陸全域の麻疹流行を扱うが、対象国リストではブラジルのみ該当。ブラジルで2件の輸入症例（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ）が確認されている。2025年から2026年の症例数の急増（15,300以上）、地域のエンデミック伝播排除状態喪失（2025年11月）、ワクチン接種率の不十分さ（2回目接種77.46%）が懸念材料。PAHO による公式な国家向け呼び掛けにより社会政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Virus Nipah India Qué Es Y Qué Síntomas Vigilar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah Virus in India: What It Is and What Symptoms to Watch For
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-25, Nipah virus in India has triggered renewed health alerts due to its capacity to spread and the lack of a specific treatment. Public health teams are closely monitoring, aiming for early detection, isolation of suspected cases, and rigorous contact tracing. Transmission can occur through direct contact with sick people, exposure to bodily fluids, consumption of contaminated foods in risk zones, and settings with poor hygiene. Early illness can resemble other viral diseases; warning signs include high fever, severe headache, malaise, and drowsiness, with more severe cases showing neurological symptoms and respiratory trouble. Containment focuses on limiting contact, enhancing epidemiological surveillance, isolating confirmed cases, and protecting healthcare environments while assessing exposure scenarios. Citizens are urged to follow authorities, maintain hand hygiene, seek medical care for fever or recent exposure, and avoid unverified information. Risk varies by region and exposure, emphasizing coordinated public health response.

triage.headline_ja: インドのニパウイルス：それは何か、注視すべき症状
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスはIHR基準を満たし（重症度、国際拡大リスク、異常性），インドでの警戒アラート発令による社会的・政治的関心も高い。公式な公衆衛生対応が進行中である。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは高い死亡率（40～75%）を持つ重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。インド当局による公式な健康警戒アラート発令と積極的な監視体制の構築が確認されている。接触感染・飛沫感染のリスクがあり、国際的な拡大可能性がある。2026年4月25日時点での新規検出または再検出イベントと解釈される。

article.articleHeadline: 蚊子大军疯狂来袭，北极圈也被攻破_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Massive Army of Mosquitoes Invades in a Frenzy; the Arctic Circle Is Breached.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever and chikungunya threats are expanding as mosquitoes proliferate, with the Arctic breached after Iceland recorded three Aedes sightings in 2025. Ae. aegypti has been found at 2302 m in Colombia, and malaria vectors at 3500 m in Bolivia, while Iceland also reports incursion; mosquitoes now inhabit high latitudes and elevations once deemed mosquito-free. Global estimates place ~3,500 mosquito species and about 1.1×10^14 individuals, with Northern Hemisphere summer peaks near 1×10^15. Climate change and glacier loss drive microclimate shifts that aid colonization. The 2025 World Malaria Report documents growing resistance: Anopheles mosquitoes resistant to four major insecticides; Plasmodium falciparum resistance to rapid tests and artemisinin. Gates Foundation’s Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes in Colombia’s Aburra Valley cut dengue by 94–97% and protected over 16 million people by 2026. Past releases (e.g., Oxitec in Brazil) have caused unintended persistence. Mosquitoes remain a major global public health driver.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の大軍が猛烈に襲来し、北極圏も突破される
triage.triage_reason: デング熱、チクングニア、マラリアなど複数の蚊媒介感染症が、北極圏を含む従来は非流行地での異常な拡大を示�ており、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）2つ以上、WPRO基準（異常性・長期曝露・流行可能性）複数該当。気候変動による蚊の分布拡大は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事では複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア、マラリア）の脅威が記載されており、ブラジルでのOxitec蚊の意図しない生着の報告あり。発生地域リストに含まれるボリビア・コロンビアは対象国外のため除外。アイスランド・北極圏での蚊確認は対象国に該当しないが、記事の主題は気候変動による蚊の全球的分布拡大であり、公衆衛生上の重大懸念。ゲイツ財団によるウォルバキア蚊の成功事例も記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: ملیریا خطرناک بیماری ، احتیاطی تدابیر ضروری - Siasat Daily - Urdu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria is a dangerous disease; precautionary measures are essential.
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day in Sangareddy, the district health department organized a public awareness rally and launched district-wide malaria prevention programs. Malaria is a serious disease transmitted by mosquitoes. Preventive measures include eliminating water accumulation around homes, maintaining cleanliness, using bed nets at night, and seeking prompt medical evaluation for fever, chills, body pains, or weakness. Doctors advise against taking medicines without medical advice. District Health Officer Dr. Venkata Rao urged residents to visit the nearest government hospital if malaria symptoms appear to enable timely control. The initiative targets nursing homes, medical colleges, and rural areas to educate communities and protect against malaria.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアは危険な病気です。予防措置が必須です。
triage.triage_reason: インドのテランガーナ州サンガレディで世界マラリア・デーに合わせた予防啓発活動が実施されたという報道。既知の風土病であり、公衆衛生上の新規シグナルではなく、定期的な予防キャンペーンの報道に過ぎない。
triage.notes: これは世界マラリア・デー（4月25日）に合わせたルーチン的な公衆衛生啓発キャンペーンの報道。患者数増加、異常な重症度、予期しないアウトブレイクなど、新規シグナルを示す情報は記事サマリーに含まれていない。インドではマラリアは風土病であり、既知のリスク。

article.articleHeadline: Pusztító vírus ütötte fel a fejét: ugyanúgy terjed, mint a koronavírus, de alig van túlélő
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A devastating virus has reared its head: it spreads just like the coronavirus, but there are hardly any survivors.
article.articleSummary: Lujo virus, named from the first two letters of Lusaka and Johannesburg, caused an outbreak about two decades ago in Zambia and South Africa, with an 80% case fatality rate. Although it is termed a hemorrhagic fever, bleeding is not a common symptom. After onset, patients may briefly improve before developing respiratory, cardiovascular, and neurological problems. The virus spilled over from animals to humans, akin to SARS-CoV-2. In 2008, the outbreak affected five people. Healthcare settings, especially crowded clinics, can amplify transmission. The event underscores the high lethality and the potential for rapid deterioration after initial stabilization, highlighting the need for early recognition and avoiding crowded care environments to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 破壊的なウイルスが台頭：コロナウイルスと同じように拡散するが、生存者はほぼいない
triage.triage_reason: 2008年の過去イベントの報道であり、現在の活動的な感染症イベントではない。ただしLujo virusの高い致死率（80%）と人獣共通感染の特性から、再発への警戒情報として監視対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事は2008年に発生したLujo virus感染症の過去イベントに関する報道。配信日時は2026年4月25日だが、実際の感染症イベントは約20年前（2008年）であり、現在の活動的なアウトブレイクではない。南アフリカ（Johannesburg）も発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに南アフリカは含まれていないためverified_locationsに含めていない。IHR基準を満たす案件だが、過去イベントの報道という性質とザンビアのみが対象国である点からWATCHと判定。続報で現在の新規感染例があるか注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vacinação contra chikungunya começa segunda em Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya Vaccination Begins Monday in Dourados.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination begins Monday, April 27, in Dourados, southern Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, across all municipal health units as the city confronts a major outbreak. Eight deaths have been confirmed; thousands of suspected and confirmed cases reported, with 59–72% positivity in the last 15 days, indicating high viral circulation. The campaign targets adults 18–59 with a single-dose vaccine developed by Valneva in partnership with Instituto Butantan and approved by Anvisa in April 2025; pre-vaccination clinical screening is required due to contraindications. Dourados reports about 5,000 probable cases and over 2,000 confirmations, with seven of the eight deaths among residents of the Indigenous Reserve. A 90-day public health calamity was declared to ease hospital strain. Part of a Ministry of Health pilot in high-transmission areas, the effort aims to vaccinate at least 27% of the target (about 43,000 people). A drive-thru vaccination is planned May 1 at the city hall.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニアワクチン接種がドゥラードスで月曜日から開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのドゥラードスで大規模なチクングニア流行が発生し、8人の死亡、5,000件の疑い患者、2,000件以上の確定患者が報告されている。高い重症度と国内的な公衆衛生上の影響が確認されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ドゥラードスはマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州南部に位置する。記事では先住民保護区での死亡者7名を含む8人の死亡が確認されている。チクングニア新規ワクチンがButantan研究所との提携によりValneva開発・Anvisa承認されており、国家規模のワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施中である。90日間の公衆衛生上の災害が宣言されている。

article.articleHeadline: Alta de casos de sarampo faz Opas convocar países para reforçar vacinação - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in measles cases prompts PAHO to call on countries to bolster vaccination - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleSummary: Measles is surging in the Americas, prompting PAHO to urge intensified vaccination during Pan American Vaccination Week (April 25–May 2, 2026). By April 5, 2026, over 15,300 measles cases had been reported, exceeding 2025’s 14,767 cases in 13 countries. The region lost endemic transmission status in November 2025. Brazil maintains 2024 recertification, but recorded two imported cases by April 6, 2026 (São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro). The 2018–2020 totals were 9,329; 21,704; 8,035. The main challenge is reaching unprotected populations; misinformation and access barriers are cited. The aim is 95% population coverage with two doses. Measles is airborne, with high contagiousness; symptoms include high fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and a rash 7–14 days after exposure. Vaccination: two doses—first at 12 months (MMR) and second at 15 months (MMR + Varicella); 1–29 years, two doses; 30–59, at least one; healthcare workers require two. Outbreak response centers on surveillance, isolation, and vaccinating contacts.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹患者数の増加により、PAHOが各国に予防接種強化を呼びかけ - ブラジリア日報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準で全5つ該当。主要地域PAHOが関与し、複数国での流行報告と社会的関心が認められるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はアメリカ地域全体での麻疹流行を扱っているが、対象国リスト内ではブラジルのみ確認。スペイン（カナリア諸島）での症例報告も示唆されているが、スペインは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。麻疹は空気感染性で高度の感染性を持つため、国際的拡大リスクが高い。2025年11月の地域流行状態喪失後の再発症例が報告されており、これは異常性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Vaccinazioni, oltre 100 milioni di dosi ai bambini contro l'epidemia di morbillo in 36 Paesi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccinations, over 100 million doses to children against the measles epidemic in 36 countries.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks are increasing globally, with about 11 million cases in 2024 and 14.3 million infants under one year unvaccinated. The Big Catch-Up (BCU) initiative, launched during World Immunization Week, has delivered over 100 million vaccine doses to about 18.3 million children in 36 countries. Of these, 12.3 million were zero-dose children who had never received any vaccine, and 15 million had never received the measles vaccine. In Africa and Asia, 60% of zero-dose children are in these 36 participating countries. Twelve countries—Burkina Faso, DPRK, Ethiopia, Kenya, Madagascar, Mauritania, Niger, Pakistan, Somalia, Togo, United Republic of Tanzania, and Zambia—reached over 60% of under-5 children who had not received any dose and had previously missed DTP1. Ethiopia vaccinated over 2.5 million zero-dose children with DTP1, plus nearly 5 million IPV doses and over 4 million measles doses; Nigeria reached 2 million zero-dose children with DTP1 and 3.4 million IPV doses. Still, 2024 global figures show 14.3 million infants under 1 without routine vaccines, underscoring the need for durable immunization systems amid rising births, conflicts, displacement, and funding pressures.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン接種：36カ国の子どもたちに対する麻疹流行対策として1億回以上のワクチン接種が実施
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の大規模な流行がアフリカ・アジア地域で多数の対象国で発生しており、IHR基準の「異常性」「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当。国際的な予防接種イニシアティブが展開されており、公開衛生への影響が深刻。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹の大規模な世界的流行（2024年約1,100万症例）とそれに対する国際的予防接種キャンペーン（Big Catch-Up）を報じている。対象国11カ国が具体的に言及されており、全て verified_locations に含める。ザンビア、エチオピア、トーゴ、ニジェール、マダガスカル、モーリタニア、パキスタン、ソマリア、北朝鮮、ケニア、タンザニアの12カ国が50%以上の高い予防接種率を達成している。流行の継続性と多数国での同時発生がWPRO基準全てに該当する重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Mizoram continues to hold first position in malaria prevalence in India since 2024
article.articleSummary: Mizoram continues to hold the top position in India’s malaria prevalence based on the Annual Parasite Incidence (API) since 2024, as World Malaria Day was observed in Aizawl. State malaria officials report that while overall malaria prevalence has fallen by about 45% this year compared with 2024, Mizoram remains the country’s highest-burden state. The districts reporting the highest prevalence are Siaha, Lawngtlai and Lunglei in the south, and Mamit in the north-west. The article does not provide exact case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or infection sources, nor mention imported or exported cases. This ongoing persistence underscores Mizoram’s continued malaria challenge and the need for sustained public health efforts to reduce transmission across these districts, as of 25 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ミゾラム州はインドにおけるマラリア有病率で2024年以降首位を保ち続けている
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは常在疾患であり、ミゾラム州での継続的な高い有病率は公衆衛生上の懸念であるが、新規アウトブレイク、異常な増加、または国際的拡大のリスクの具体的な証拠が記事に示されていない。引き続き情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: マラリアはインド（特にミゾラム州）の常在疾患であり、新規アウトブレイク要素や国際的拡大リスクの明確な証拠が記事に含まれていない。ただし、ミゾラム州が2024年以来インドにおけるマラリア有病率で首位を占めており、複数県で継続的に高い患者数が報告されているため、長期的な曝露と流行しやすさの基準に該当する。公式なワールド・マラリア・デー関連の報道があり、政府・世間の関心は高い。具体的な症例数、死亡数、検査確認、感染源などの詳細情報は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand Fights Malaria: Panchayat Leaders Honored for Disease Control Efforts
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day, Jharkhand’s health department honored 10 panchayat representatives (mukhiyas) for leading malaria and lymphatic/filariasis awareness and community participation. NHM Jharkhand Director Shashi Prakash Jha emphasized regular spraying, mosquito nets, clean drains, and village-level ownership to curb malaria, with prevention, early detection, and timely treatment as key. Jharkhand reported 42,236 malaria cases in 2025, concentrated in West Singhbhum, East Singhbhum, Seraikela-Kharsawan, Godda, Pakur, and Sahibganj. In the first three months of 2026, about 4,000 malaria cases were recorded statewide. Testing coverage included 14.69 lakh rapid diagnostic tests (RDT) and over 55 lakh slide-based malaria tests. Birendra Kumar Singh noted ongoing focus on reducing malaria and eliminating kala-azar. Eight districts—Bokaro, Chatra, Deoghar, Dhanbad, Koderma, Palamu, Ramgarh, Jamtara—reported fewer than 100 malaria cases last year.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州はマラリアと闘う：疾病管理の努力で村落指導者が表彰される
triage.triage_reason: インドのジャールカンド州でマラリア、リンパ系フィラリア症、ビスセラル・リーシュマニア症の発生が報告されており、複数のスクリーニング基準（異常性と長期曝露）に該当するが、記事は主に予防・管理の取り組みと成功事例に焦点を当てており、急速に拡大する危機的状況の兆候は不明確。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はWorld Malaria Dayの文脈での予防啓発と管理成功の表彰が主題。2025年に42,236件のマラリア症例、2026年最初の3ヶ月で4,000件が報告されており、長期的な曝露と流行しやすい環境が確認できるが、急速拡大や国際的懸念の兆候は不明。政府による積極的な取り組みが報告されているため、管理可能性は相対的に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Minister Venkatesh inaugurates FMD vax drive in Belagavi
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccination drive in Belagavi, Karnataka, marks the ninth round, launched at the Speciality Veterinary Hospital, Mahantesh Nagar, on World Veterinary Day. The programme aims to vaccinate livestock to prevent FMD spread and improve animal health. It is organized by the district administration, zilla panchayat, the Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services department (Bengaluru), and the District Cooperative Milk Producers’ Union, Belagavi. Inaugurating the event, Animal Husbandry Minister K Venkatesh noted dairy farming as a family-based rural occupation and said state milk production has risen from 70–80 lakh litres to over one crore litres daily; a 25% subsidy supports poor farmers, with about 20,000 cows distributed in Belagavi and Kalaburagi. Ministers Satish Jarkiholi and Laxmi Hebbalkar stressed vaccination’s importance, and officials expect the drive to be completed within a month.

triage.headline_ja: ベラガウィで動物大臣がFMD（口蹄疫）ワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は口蹄疫の予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、アウトブレイク事象ではない。影響カテゴリが動物に限定され、公衆衛生的な危機的状況を示していない。
triage.notes: 本件は口蹄疫の発症・流行の報告ではなく、カルナタカ州ベラガウィにおける動物向けのワクチン接種プログラムの開始であり、シグナル検出の対象外。予防的施策の実施であるため、感染症危機として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: '7 child deaths in Salumber due to unknown illness'
article.articleSummary: Seven children died in April in Ghata, Lalpura and Kunda villages of Lasadiya block, Salumber district, Rajasthan, linked to an unknown illness. Government says seven deaths this month, countering opposition claims of 15; other area fatalities attributed to pneumonia, malaria, and diarrhoea. All seven children showed similar symptoms—seizures and vomiting—before death, with the cause undetermined pending post-mortem. The latest case, a five-year-old girl, had blood in vomit and seizures. A post-mortem on one Kunda child is awaited to establish the cause. Preliminary tests among sick children indicate malaria and diarrhoea. Health authorities formed seven medical survey teams; the Animal Husbandry Department is checking livestock for possible animal-to-human transmission. About 2,500 residents of Kunda are cooperating with responders.

triage.headline_ja: サルンベルで正体不明の病気により7人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な影響・異常性・国際的リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度と長期曝露で該当。複数村での小児死亡、原因不明、動物感染の可能性調査により、フルRRA実施の対象となる。
triage.notes: ラジャスターン州サルンベル地区の複数村（ガタ、ラルプラ、クンダ）で7人の小児死亡事例。原因は未確定で、痙攣・嘔吐・血便が共通症状。マラリア、下痢、肺炎が検査で示唆されているが、動物由来感染の可能性も調査中。政府と野党で死者数の報告が異なる（政府7名対野党15名）点も注目。

article.articleHeadline: Lawngtlai DC bans cattle import from Myanmar amid FMD endemic
article.articleSummary: Lawngtlai district in South Mizoram bans cattle imports from Myanmar for two months due to foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) endemic in Myanmar, especially near Lawngtlai. Deputy Commissioner Donny Lalruatsanga issued the order under BNSS 2023 Section 165; violators face punishment under BNS 2023 Section 223. The ban covers the entire district from Friday to protect cows and buffaloes within the district and curb cross-border risk amid Myanmar’s boundary with nearby Chin state and ongoing unregulated trade. Background: in November 2025, at least 10 people died in Lawngtlai and adjoining Siaha districts from cross-border cholera infections traced to Myanmar.

triage.headline_ja: ミャンマーのFMD流行に伴いロングタライ地区が家畜輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）とコレラの2疾患が関連地域で報告されており、国際的な越境リスク（ミャンマー・インド境界）があり、過去にはコレラで死亡者も発生している。異常かつ公衆衛生への影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーには2つの疾患が関連：(1) 口蹄疫（FMD）はミャンマーで流行しており、インド側ロングタライ地区への越境リスク対策として家畜輸入禁止措置が発令。(2) コレラについては2025年11月に同地区で少なくとも10人の死亡者が報告され、ミャンマーからの感染が確認されている。越境感染の歴史があり、地域的な公衆衛生危機の継続性が示唆される。ミャンマーはWPRO地域に属し、スクリーニング基準を全て満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Panacea Pharmacy donates medicines to Mamprobi Polyclinic, pushes affordable healthcare on World Malaria Day - MyJoyOnline
article.articleSummary: Malaria and access to affordable treatment in Ghana: On World Malaria Day (April 25, 2026), Panacea Pharmacy Limited donated essential medicines to Mamprobi Polyclinic in Accra to improve treatment access for vulnerable patients. The gesture aims to challenge the notion that quality medicines must be expensive, addressing delays in treatment for patients without health insurance amid ongoing out-of-pocket costs despite NHIS. At Mamprobi Polyclinic, the donated medicines are expected to support malaria treatment delivery and ease financial barriers for low-income patients. Dr Nanayaw Appiah Amoah emphasized affordability and timely treatment; Dr Rita Owusu, Head of Pharmacy, urged the public to prioritize malaria prevention, including use of insecticide-treated nets and environmental hygiene, to reduce infection. Malaria remains a leading public health concern in Ghana with high outpatient visits, particularly among children and pregnant women, underscoring the value of private-public partnerships to strengthen healthcare delivery.

triage.headline_ja: パナセア薬局がマンプロビ診療所に医薬品を寄付、世界マラリアデーで安価なヘルスケアを推進 - MyJoyOnline
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは周知の風土病であり、本記事は医薬品寄付と予防啓発の慈善活動に関するもので、新規の感染症クラスター、異常な発生、または緊急の公衆衛生脅威を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は世界マラリアデーの社会的キャンペーンであり、感染症の異常発生や危機的状況を示唆していない。マラリアはガーナの風土病であり、本件は医薬品へのアクセス改善に関する定期的なヘルスケア活動である。

article.articleHeadline: Experts Urge Stronger Malaria Prevention
article.articleSummary: As of 25 April 2026, on World Malaria Day, Telangana authorities and public-health scientists urged stronger malaria prevention, focusing on chemoprophylaxis in high‑risk zones and ensuring malaria screening in corporate hospitals. At Hyderabad and urban centers, malaria incidence has declined, notably P. falciparum–related cases, but pockets persist in tribal and forested areas such as Asifabad, Adilabad, and Bhadadri Kothagudem. Primary Health Centres with rapid diagnostic kits are well‑placed to test fever patients, while corporate hospitals are urged to adopt routine screening. Plasmodium vivax remains a concern due to its dormant liver stage and relapses; relapse data for Telangana are limited. Malaria transmission involves mosquitoes and parasites can inhabit primates and rodents, highlighting a broader ecological reservoir. The event, organized by AIC‑CCMB with Consytel Life Sciences, ties to India's malaria-elimination roadmap for 2030, emphasizing investment, innovation, and the “last mile.”

triage.headline_ja: マラリア防止対策の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドのテランガナ州におけるマラリア（非ファルシパルム種および全般）の予防強化に関する呼びかけ記事。異常性・予想外性は限定的だが、公衆衛生への継続的な関心を反映した報道であり、情報不足のため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア日（4月25日）に際しての予防啓発イベント報道であり、急性の感染症アウトブレイク現象ではなく、継続的な公衆衛生課題への政策的対応を描写している。テランガナ州の都市部では発生減少傾向を示す一方、部族地域と森林地帯での流行継続が言及されている。スクリーニング基準での「長期曝露」と「流行容易性」は該当するが、IHR基準は非該当のため、情報充実を待つWATCHレベルの判定。

article.articleHeadline: OVALE: Influencer de SJC faz alerta a jovens após infecção por HIV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: O Vale: SJC influencer warns young people after HIV infection.
article.articleSummary: São José dos Campos, Brazil-based hairdresser and influencer Iago Rabello, 32, revealed in a video that he is living with HIV after an unprotected sexual encounter. The disclosure is intended to warn young people about the risks of unprotected sex. Rabello stresses that HIV is a serious issue for all youths and anyone who engages in sex without condoms, framing the message as a serious public health alert rather than drama. The report notes his motivation to inform his followers and local readers as of 25 April 2026. It also mentions links to join local WhatsApp news channels for updates.

triage.headline_ja: OVALE: SJC の影響力者が HIV 感染後、若者に警告
triage.triage_reason: 個人の HIV 感染開示であり、公衆衛生上の異常な集団発症や流行の兆候ではない。社会的関心は限定的で、IHR 基準および WPRO スクリーニング基準をいずれも満たさない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは個人による HIV 感染の公開告白であり、公衆衛生監視の対象とすべき集団発症や流行ではない。公衆啓発キャンペーンの性質を持つもので、感染症危機管理の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: தொழிற்சாலையில் மலேரியா நோய் கண்டறியும் முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria detection camp at the factory
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day, a malaria-detection camp was held in the Tirunallar area of Karaikal as part of the National Vector-Borne Disease Control Programme. The event took place on Saturday, April 25, 2026, at a private iron factory in Tirunallar. It was inaugurated by Dr. A. Sivarajkumar, Deputy Director of the Karaikal Health Department, to bolster malaria surveillance among workers and the local population. The article reports no specific malaria case counts or laboratory-confirmation results. The camp underscores ongoing public health outreach in industrial settings to identify malaria infections early and prevent transmission within the Karaikal region. By aligning with World Malaria Day objectives, the programme aims to strengthen detection, awareness, and control measures in coordination with district health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 工場におけるマラリア検査キャンプ
triage.triage_reason: マラリア検査キャンプの実施報告であり、具体的な患者数や感染確認がない啓発活動。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はWorld Malaria Day に合わせた定期的な検査・啓発キャンプの実施報告であり、疾病クラスタや異常な発生の報告ではない。具体的な患者数や実験室確認がなく、対象地域（インド・プドゥチェリ連邦直轄領）における既知のマラリア問題の日常的な対応として位置付けられる。シグナルとして取り上げる必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Uncovered illegally mined pits drive high malaria cases in Amansie West District - Adomonline.com
article.articleSummary: Malaria cases are rising in Ghana’s Amansie West District, with OPD malaria cases climbing from >36,000 in 2024 to >38,000 in 2025. Among children under five, cases increased from 8,000 in 2024 to 10,000 in 2025. Health officials attribute the surge to uncovered pits from illegal mining (galamsey), which serve as mosquito breeding grounds across communities. District Director of Health Services Bernard Badu Bediako urged collective action and praised Asanko Gold Ghana Limited for supporting malaria control, education, and elimination efforts, including emphasis on completing full anti-malarial courses and using long-lasting insecticide-treated nets despite discomfort. For World Malaria Day 2026, Asanko Gold organized free health screenings in Manso Abore and surrounding areas, including malaria testing and general medical checks. The company distributed over 2,000 insecticide-treated nets to SHS students and outlined investments in healthcare infrastructure, such as CHPS compounds at Tetrem and Krofrom, to improve access to services. The theme: “Driven to End Malaria: Now We Can. Now We Must.”

triage.headline_ja: 違法採掘されたむき出しのピットがアマンシー・ウェスト地区のマラリア患者数の増加を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: ガーナでマラリア症例の増加が報告されており、異常性と環境要因（違法採掘による蚊の繁殖地）が確認されるが、現在のところ致死率や国際的拡大の具体的証拠がなく、情報がやや限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO推奨ハイライトはダブルテストを通した正規マラリア患者報告ではなく、OPDベースの患者数増加（2024年36,000件→2025年38,000件）であることが識別される。違法採掘による蚊の繁殖地増加という環境的根拠が明確で、特に5歳以下の小児患者増加（8,000→10,000件）が懸念される。IHR基準は2つ該当し、WPRO基準は4つ該当するが、記事には死亡率や重症度に関する明確なデータがなく、現在の情報では国際的な拡大リスクも低いと評価される。国内の公衆衛生対応（蚊帳配布、CHPS施設整備など）が既に進行中であり、継続的な監視が適切と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Surveillance intensifies amid malaria infections at Aldona
article.articleSummary: 11 malaria cases among migrant laborers detected in Aldona, Bardez, Goa, from March 31 to April 22, with infections concentrated at a construction site in Carona. All cases are imported, involving workers recently arrived from Assam and Uttar Pradesh. In response, Aldona PHC launched containment: mass blood screening, anti-larval measures, and extensive fogging across the site. Cases were identified after fever symptoms during routine medical examinations for the labour force. Local anxiety over potential transmission; officials say Goa remains malaria-free, with no locally transmitted case since 2022 and no malaria deaths since 2018. Authorities emphasize there is no cause for panic and urge contractors and residents to remove stagnant water and maintain hygiene to prevent mosquito breeding, as the state observes World Malaria Day. As of 25 April 2026, surveillance continues in Bardez.

triage.headline_ja: Aldona でのマラリア感染の中で監視活動が強化
triage.triage_reason: インドのGoaで輸入マラリア11例が検出された局所的イベント。IHR基準は2つ以上該当しないが、スクリーニング基準で異常性（輸入例の集中）と管理可能性に該当。ただし全例輸入例で、当局が「パニックの必要なし」と明言し、Goa州は2022年以降local transmissionなし。情報不足のため経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、11例すべてが輸入例（Assam及びUttar Pradeshからの出稼ぎ労働者）で、Goa州では2022年以降のlocal transmissionなし。当局が積極的な封じ込め対策（mass blood screening、anti-larval measures、fogging）を実施中。死亡例なし。ただしmigrant laborersの追加流入リスクと、建設サイトでの環境的リスク要因が存在する。情報不足により確定的なRRA判定を保留。

article.articleHeadline: Descubren en Kenia un nuevo coronavirus en murciélagos capaz de infectar células humanas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New coronavirus found in bats in Kenya that can infect human cells
article.articleSummary: {"description":"CcCoV-KY43, a new coronavirus identified in Kenyan bats, can enter human cells via the CEACAM6 receptor, signaling a potential zoonotic entry route. The spike protein binds the N-terminal immunoglobulin-like domain of CEACAM6, and overexpression of CEACAM6 renders human cells susceptible in vitro. The study, published in Nature, involves the University of Cambridge and Pirbright Institute with collaborators from the KEMRI-Wellcome Trust, Hull York Medical School, Imperial College London, Conservation Loisaba, and the National Museums of Kenya. Testing spikes from 27 bat coronaviruses against human receptors showed CcCoV-KY43 uses CEACAM6; related Kenyan bat CoVs displayed similar usage. Some bat coronaviruses from Russia and China may use comparable receptors in other mammals. Serology in nearby Kenyan populations showed no evidence of recent infection. Limitations include the use of synthetic proteins and cell models rather than the full virus; underscores the need for stronger wildlife coronavirus surveillance and monitoring CEACAM6 as an entry route."}

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのコウモリで発見された人間の細胞に感染可能な新型コロナウイルス
triage.triage_reason: 新規コロナウイルスの動物由来ウイルス学的特性に関する研究報告だが、ヒト感染例はなく（血清検査陰性）、実験的知見に基づくシグナルである。情報不足のため引き続き監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアで発見された新規コロナウイルスに関する研究報告（Nature掲載）。動物由来ウイルスの人間受容体への結合能力を示すin vitro研究であるが、ケニアの近隣集団での血清学的調査で最近の感染兆候なし。ロシアと中国のコウモリコロナウイルスについても言及されているが、記事の主題はケニアの発見。実際のヒト感染例や流行報告はないため、スクリーニング基準数は限定的。社会的関心（メディア報道）は認められるがzoonotic potentialの基礎研究段階であり、即座のアウトブレイクリスク証拠は提示されていない。verified_locationsはサマリーに基づき、言及された対象国はChina（ロシアのコウモリコロナウイルスについても言及があるが、ロシアは対象国外）。

article.articleHeadline: City reports high malaria cases beyond peak season
article.articleSummary: As of 25 April 2026, malaria in Mumbai remains high beyond peak season, complicating India's WHO 2030 elimination target. Between Jan 1 and Apr 21, Mumbai recorded 1,773 malaria cases—the highest in Maharashtra—while Gadchiroli had 348. In 2025, Mumbai reported 10,163 malaria cases, up from 7,939 in 2024. Maharashtra averages about 74–75 malaria cases per day in 2025–26, with Mumbai contributing roughly 28 daily cases (30–40% of the state total), underscoring urban vulnerability. Case persistence through summer reflects shifting transmission, linked to intermittent rainfall, early monsoon, and infrastructure-driven stagnant water that favors Anopheles mosquitoes. Public-health experts attribute the surge to climate and urban factors, noting that blood tests can miss very early malaria and stressing the need for effective control. The data show ongoing challenges in meeting elimination goals despite awareness campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: ピーク時期を過ぎても高いマラリア症例を報告する都市
triage.triage_reason: インドのマラリア症例増加は公衆衛生上の懸念があり、WHO 2030排除目標への影響が示唆されているが、死亡や入院の具体的情報が不足しており、現時点では完全な評価が困難。
triage.notes: マラリア症例がピーク時期を過ぎても高い水準にあり、2025年10,163件から2026年1-4月で1,773件（既存ペースで年換算約5,300件と推定される）と増加傾向。気候変動と都市インフラの関連性が指摘されており、スクリーニング基準では4項目該当。ただしIHR基準では深刻度・国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクについて具体情報が不足している。継続的な情報監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kicukiro residents urged to take lead in fight against Malaria
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a significant burden in Rwanda as of 25 April 2026, with 928,616 cases logged between July 2025 and March 2026. The most affected districts are Gisagara (216,350), Gasabo (98,077), Bugesera (74,073), and Kicukiro (65,297); in March 2026 Ngoma (8,527), Kayonza (5,839), Gasabo (5,709), Kicukiro (2,941), and Gisagara (2,769) accounted for 55% of monthly cases. In Kigali’s Kicukiro District, Gahanga Sector residents were urged to combat malaria by consistently using insecticide-treated nets, maintaining hygiene, clearing mosquito breeding sites, and participating in Umuganda aligned with World Malaria Day. RBC, with Strive Foundation Rwanda and NGO Forum for HIV/AIDS and Health Promotions, distributed nets and education. The malaria strategy includes Multiple First-line Treatment (MFT), ASPY in Southern/Northern provinces, Coartem/DHAP elsewhere, indoor residual spraying in 96 sectors, and distribution of 2.9 million nets (1.1 million already provided), nets lasting 2–3 years.

triage.headline_ja: キクキロ住民にマラリアとの戦いで率先した行動を促す
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは既知の風土病であり、ルワンダで行われている公衆衛生キャンペーンの記事。異常性や国際的拡大のリスクが認められず、IHR基準は2つ以上該当しない。
triage.notes: ルワンダの既知のマラリア流行に対する公衆衛生対応の報告。928,616例（2025年7月～2026年3月）は確実に多数であるが、同地域での継続的な課題であり異常性（unexpected）に欠ける。DRC（対象国）が地理的に隣接していても、記事の主題はルワンダの国内対応。HIV は疾患タグに含まれているが、記事本体ではマラリアが主焦点であり、HIV については言及不十分。

article.articleHeadline: مقال : نبيل عليوه - اليوم العالمي للملاريا..مناسبة للتقييم والتحشيد لمكافحتها
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Article: Nabil Aliouh - World Malaria Day: An opportunity for assessment and mobilization to fight it.
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day, April 25, highlights malaria, a vector-borne parasitic disease caused mainly by Plasmodium falciparum (most deadly) and P. vivax (relapses). Transmission occurs via female Anopheles mosquitoes; infection begins in the liver, then invades red blood cells, causing fever, chills, headaches, and fatigue. Incubation is 7–30 days; severe disease can cause anemia, kidney failure, jaundice, cerebral malaria, ARDS, or shock. Malaria remains in over 80 countries, concentrated in hot, humid regions; Nigeria, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and Mozambique are among the most affected, with pockets in India, Pakistan, and Indonesia. Drivers include climate change, poverty, drug and insecticide resistance, and conflict-driven displacement. Diagnosis uses blood smears, rapid tests, and PCR. Treatments are Artemisinin-based, with IV artesunate for severe cases and primaquine after G6PD testing; prevention emphasizes vector control, nets, traveler prophylaxis, and vaccines RTS,S/AS01 and R21. International cooperation and surveillance remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: 記事：ナビル・アリウー - 世界マラリアデー：マラリア対策の評価と動員の機会
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は世界マラリアデーの啓発記事であり、新規の感染症イベント・アウトブレイク報告ではない。既知の流行国の状況説明に過ぎず、特定のシグナル基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界マラリアデー（4月25日）に関連する啓発・レビュー記事であり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。既知の流行地域の疾病負荷について一般的に述べているもので、シグナル検出の対象外。記事サマリーに対象国が複数含まれるが、いずれも既知の風土病地域の説明に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: H5N1 containment operation: Health dept confirms no human cases
article.articleSummary: H5N1 outbreak at the state poultry rearing training centre in Mathkuru village, Hesaraghatta, Karnataka, prompted a 10-day intensive surveillance and containment operation; no human cases detected so far. An infected zone (0–3 km) and a surveillance zone (3–10 km) were established; birds culled and eggs and contaminated feed disposed per biosecurity protocols. Health teams surveyed 28,172 people across 22 villages within 10 km. Nasopharyngeal samples from quarantined staff on day 5 tested negative; day 10 results are awaited. Bengaluru healthcare facilities monitor influenza-like illness (ILI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) and maintain stocks of PPE and antivirals. A 90-day poultry activity ban at the affected centre is in place, with disinfection every 15 days. Public advised to avoid handling sick or dead poultry, ensure thorough cooking of meat and eggs, and report unusual bird deaths; avoid spreading unverified information.

triage.headline_ja: H5N1封じ込め作戦：保健部門が人間の感染者がいないことを確認
triage.triage_reason: カルナータカ州の家禽飼育訓練センターでのH5N1発生は、国際的な関心が高い高病原性インフルエンザであり、IHR基準（異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、流行しやすさ、長期曝露）も複数該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: H5N1は高病原性インフルエンザウイルスであり、世界的な監視対象疾患。現在のところ人間感染は検出されていないが、10,000人以上が調査対象となっており、継続的な監視が必要。家禽施設での発生であるため、動物から人への感染リスク評価が重要。90日間の家禽活動禁止令と段階的なサーベイランスが実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: 「ポリオのない未来へ」　慈善公演で楽しみながら啓発　　ロータリー奄美
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Toward a polio-free future: Raising awareness while enjoying a charity performance — Rotary Amami
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-25, a charity concert END POLIO NOW, organized by Rotary International District 2730 Amami Group, was held at Ama Home Plaza in Naze, Amami City, with about 200 attendees. Now in its second year, the event featured island songs, a wind ensemble, and a magic show to raise polio awareness and support eradication efforts. Rotary International, founded in Chicago in 1905, has sustained global polio programs since 1979, beginning with immunization in the Philippines. Polio is caused by the poliovirus and primarily affects children under five; transmission is fecal-oral, potentially causing paralysis or death, but vaccination prevents infection. The Amami group comprises four clubs—Amami, Amami Central, Amami Setouchi, and Amami Central Rotaract—with polio displays and fundraising at the venue.

triage.headline_ja: 「ポリオのない未来へ」　慈善公演で楽しみながら啓発　　ロータリー奄美
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポリオ根絶のための慈善公演・啓発イベントの報道であり、ポリオの新規発生やアウトブレイクではない。疫学的な危機要因がなく、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: この記事は実際のポリオ患者報告やアウトブレイクではなく、ロータリー・インターナショナルによるポリオ根絶キャンペーンの慈善公演についての報道である。歴史的背景（フィリピンでの1979年の予防接種開始）を含むが、現在の感染症イベントではない。Bluedot APIが検出した地域情報（フィリピン、米国、日本など）は記事の文脈上のみであり、実際のポリオ発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : négliger les mesures de prévention contre le paludisme expose l'enfant (un pédiatre) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Neglecting malaria prevention measures exposes the child (a pediatrician) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a leading cause of illness and death among children in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with infants 0–2 years most at risk. In Kinshasa’s Bumbu commune, Dr. Kabeya Justin, a pediatrician at Hôpital Source de Vie, warns that neglecting preventive measures endangers children. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes. The DRC faces a heavy burden, with millions of children affected annually, especially under-5s; factors include limited access to care, insufficient parental awareness, insecticide/parasite resistance, and poor living conditions. Preventive actions: sleeping under insecticide-treated nets, eliminating standing water, dressing children in covering clothing in the evening, and regular health follow-up. If a infant shows malaria symptoms, seek immediate health care, avoid self-medication, complete prescribed treatment, and monitor for severe signs (convulsions, inability to drink, drowsiness). World Malaria Day underscores that prevention saves lives.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: マラリア予防対策の軽視は子どもを危険にさらす（小児科医） - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 記事はDRCにおけるマラリアの予防啓発に関する医学的見解であり、新規の感染症流行イベントや異常な増加を報告するものではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はWorld Malaria Day関連のルーチン的な予防啓発記事である。DRCでのマラリア負担は既知の慢性疾患であり、新規の異常イベントや流行増加を示すデータなし。シグナル判定の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: ANDREW MORPHEW | Sea change needed in government's approach to fighting FMD
article.articleSummary: Foot and mouth disease (FMD) outbreaks in South Africa threaten rural livelihoods as beef and dairy prices rise. To halt transmission, 14-million cattle must be vaccinated within six to eight weeks, a window far tighter than the plan to immunise 80% by December. Waning immunity after four to six months risks renewed spread, with farm losses estimated at up to R5,000 per sick cow in milk revenue and as much as R5 million per outbreak on a 1,000-cow dairy farm. FMD Response SA calls for full private-sector involvement in vaccine importing, procurement and distribution; KwaZulu-Natal’s 34 private veterinarians could vaccinate up to 50,000 cattle per day, suggesting national targets could be met in two months. Brazil and Argentina’s decentralised vaccination models offer a blueprint; Deputy Director-General Serage signaled willingness to enable private procurement and emergency permits to accelerate access.

triage.headline_ja: ANDREW MORPHEW | 口蹄疫対策に関する政府アプローチの転換が必要
triage.triage_reason: 南アフリカの口蹄疫アウトブレイクは異常で予想外であり、農業部門に重大な経済的影響をもたらす。地域内での蔓延リスクが高く、国際的な拡大懸念（ブラジル・アルゼンチンとの比較言及）も存在する。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な舞台は南アフリカ（対象国リストに含まれないため除外）であり、ブラジルとアルゼンチンはワクチン接種モデルの参照事例として言及されている。対象国リストに基づくと、ブラジルのみ verified_locations に含める。南アフリカでの同疾患の確認は重要だが、本スクリーニングの対象国外のため、ブラジルの参照のみを記録する。実質的には地理的スコープ外のシグナルだが、IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPRO基準5つ全て該当することから、フルRRA進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm B đang gây nhiều ca bệnh nguy kịch với diễn biến nhanh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza B is causing many critical cases with rapid progression.
article.articleSummary: Influenza B can begin with non-specific symptoms and rapidly progress to pneumonia and respiratory failure in the elderly or those with chronic diseases. The Emergency Department at the National Institute of Infectious and Tropical Diseases has seen several severe Influenza B cases. Among them: T.T.N., 77, Hanoi, admitted after 4 days of fatigue and headache; pneumonia with respiratory failure; required oxygen (2–3 L/min); SpO2 94–95%; influenza B positive; hypertension. N.H.H., 60, Hai Phong, with diabetes and hepatitis B; fever and malaise for days; treated with antivirals at a private facility; fever resolved, but dyspnea and extensive lung injury developed; transferred with progressive pneumonia on influenza B. The most severe: H.N.T., 65, Hanoi, COPD; high fever 39–40°C, productive cough, worsening dyspnea; respiratory failure requiring high-flow oxygen, then non-invasive ventilation and intubation; suspected invasive fungal co-infection. Experts stress rapid deterioration, emphasize influenza vaccination, early evaluation, and caution against self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザBが急速な進行を伴う多くの重症例を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザBによる重症化・死亡症例の報告、異常な臨床経過（急速進行、呼吸不全）が確認されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「流行しやすさ」に該当。ベトナムは対象国であり、医療機関での複数の重症例報告により公衆衛生への影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: ベトナム・ハノイの国立感染症・熱帯病研究所での複数の重症インフルエンザB症例報告。高齢者・基礎疾患患者での急速進行、呼吸不全、侵襲性真菌二次感染の疑いなど、通常のインフルエンザよりも重篤な臨床経過が報告されている。ワクチン接種と早期評価の重要性が強調されている。記事サマリーに基づき、実際の発生地はベトナムのみ。

article.articleHeadline: หมอยงวิเคราะห์ต้นตอ "ตับอักเสบ เอ" ระบาดโรงงาน-แรงงานข้ามชาติ แนะฉีดวัคซีนคุมโรค
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Yong analyzes the root cause of Hepatitis A outbreak among factory workers and migrant workers; recommends vaccination to control the disease.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A outbreak is spreading in eastern Thailand, with the virus transmitted via fecal-oral routes from contaminated water or food. Dr. Yong Poovorawan, a virologist at Chulalongkorn University, says the outbreak is broad and likely linked to migrant workers who introduce the virus into crowded factories, though pinpointing the initial source is difficult. Immunity in Thais born before and after modernization varies: most under 40 lack immunity; about 50% of those aged 40–50 are immune; those over 60 are largely immune due to prior infection. Prevention priorities include vaccination for workers in food-related industries and restaurants, improved hygiene, and handwashing after bathrooms. Seafood, especially shellfish, can harbor the virus in seawater; undercooked shellfish may disseminate infection, since heating to above 85°C neutralizes the virus. A past Shanghai outbreak is cited. More details will follow.

triage.headline_ja: ヨン博士がA型肝炎の根本原因を分析 - 工場労働者と移民労働者の中での流行。ワクチン接種による疾病管理を推奨
triage.triage_reason: タイで進行中のA型肝炎の流行が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）の3つに該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。国際的拡大リスクも存在（移民労働者を通じた感染機構が明記されている）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで「東部タイでの流行」が主題であり、Shangaiの過去の流行は参考例として言及されている。移民労働者を通じた国境を越えた感染リスクが強調されている点、および複数国での流行史が示唆する国際的リスクにより、ThailandおよびChinaを verified_locations に含める。ワクチン接種推奨による管理体制が整備されている一方、移民労働者集団での流行継続リスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: मच्छरों से होनेवाली बीमारियों के प्रति जागरूक करें : डॉ स्वराज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Raise awareness about mosquito-borne diseases: Dr. Swraj.
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day in Ramgarh, a special seminar and awareness workshop was held at the Civil Surgeon Office hall, chaired by Acting Civil Surgeon Dr. Swraj. The event aimed to educate the public about mosquito-borne diseases and promote healthier health behaviors under the theme 'Driven to End Malaria Now – We Can, We Must.' Dr. Swraj stressed protection from vector-borne diseases and malaria elimination through public awareness. Nodality officer Dr. Talika Rani led a review meeting with registered doctors to resolve tele-consultation technical issues. A large panel of physicians—including Dr. Shamim Akhtar, Dr. Jai Shri Ragni, Dr. Aparajita, Dr. Ambika Kumari, Dr. Madan Mahato, Dr. Manitap, Dr. Dilip Kumar, Dr. Manisha Kumari, Dr. Amit Anand, Vishal Tirki, Dr. Puja, Dr. Chetan, Dr. PN Singh, Dr. VK Singh, Dr. Pradeep Kumar Sinha, Dr. Pallavi Kaushal, Sunil Madhukar, Amod Kumar, Dr. Vimal Kumar Keshari, and Dr. Mo Minhaj Ansari—attended the event.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊によって伝染する病気についての意識を高めてください：Dr. Swraj
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア啓発セミナーと意識向上ワークショップの開催報告であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常な疾患発生、または公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示していない。
triage.notes: 本記事はジャルカンド州ラムガルにおけるマラリア啓発イベントの開催を報告したもので、実際の感染症アウトブレイクやサージは記述されていない。定期的な公衆衛生キャンペーンの一環であり、シグナル検知の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 南昌疾控发布最新提醒！警惕发热症状，做好防蚊防蜱防护
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nanchang CDC Issues the Latest Advisory! Be Vigilant for Fever Symptoms and Take Precautions Against Mosquitoes and Ticks.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-26, the Nanchang City Center for Disease Control and Prevention issued an advisory as May arrives, noting warmer, wetter conditions that raise risks of mosquito- and tick-borne diseases in Nanchang, Jiangxi. Key concerns: dengue fever, chikungunya fever, other infectious diarrhea, fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome, and rabies. Dengue presents with abrupt high fever (up to 40°C) and may be biphasic with rash; chikungunya features rapid fever (often >39°C), symmetric multi-joint pain, rash, fatigue, and headache. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water (pots, jars, barrels, trash cans, AC condensate), avoiding grass and shrubs outdoors, wearing long sleeves/pants, using repellents, and sleeping under nets. Tick-borne fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome causes fever around 38-40°C with fatigue, aches, and GI symptoms; higher risk in hills, mountains, forests for residents and travelers. For tick bites, remove with clean tweezers, disinfect, and monitor; seek care within two weeks if fever or malaise develops and report exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 南昌疾控発表最新警告！発熱症状に警戒し、蚊とダニの防護対策をしっかりと
triage.triage_reason: 複数の蚊媒介および刻まれた感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、SFTS、狂犬病）の公式警告であり、スクリーニング基準では「異常/予想外」および「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、現在のところ患者数や具体的な発生状況が記載されておらず、情報不足のため。
triage.notes: 南昌市疾病予防管理センターによる公式警告であり、気温上昇に伴う季節的な蚊・ダニ媒介感染症のリスク増加を取り上げたもの。デング熱、チクングニア熱、SFTS、狂犬病など複数の病原体が言及されており、流行しやすい季節となることが強調されている。ただし、現在の患者発生数や重症度についての具体的情報は記事に含まれていないため、より詳細な情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Diarrhoea & dehydration case count surges amid soaring temperatures
article.articleSummary: Diarrhoea and dehydration surge in Pune amid record heat. Over the past few days, doctors report 10–15 daily patients with loose motions, up from 3–4 earlier, plus vomiting and abdominal discomfort. Extreme heat accelerates fluid and salt loss, including sodium depletion, while unsafe drinking water and outside beverages worsen GI infections. Uncovered street foods and drinks, including juices and cut fruits, can rapidly become bacterial culture media, leading to infection and faster dehydration. A traveler moving between Mumbai and Pune arrived severely dehydrated with impaired kidney function, illustrating risks of rapid fluid loss in transit. Paediatric cases are longer and more recurrent, linked to swimming-pool exposure, tanker water of uncertain quality, and overconsumption of seasonal fruits (watermelon, muskmelon, grapes) which can cause osmotic diarrhoea. Public health guidance: avoid roadside/uncovered foods, ensure safe drinking water, hydrate with water, ORS, and balanced meals to prevent complications.

triage.headline_ja: 気温上昇に伴い下痢および脱水症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の下痢・脱水症例増加で、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・流行しやすさ）に複数該当するが、未知の病原体や重大な公衆衛生危機の兆候は明確ではなく、情報が限定的。
triage.notes: 季節性の下痢・脱水症例増加であり、記事は未知の病原体を示唆していない。高温環境下での環境衛生・飲料水品質が主要リスク要因。死亡報告や重症例の報告がないため、IHR基準の深刻な影響は認定されない。ただし、気候変動に伴う季節的リスク増加がWPRO基準で識別され、続報の注視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito control key to prevent malaria: Collector
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day in Vijayawada, NTR district collector Dr G Lakshmisha said effective mosquito control is essential to prevent malaria and other vector-borne diseases, urging active public participation. He noted that malaria, dengue, filaria and chikungunya are transmitted by mosquitoes and threaten public health. The malaria awareness rally was flagged off at the Old Government Hospital, with a call for serious preventive measures. Mosquitoes breed in stagnant water; residents should eliminate water accumulation around homes, including in flower pots, discarded containers, tyres and plastic bottles. He directed officials to intensify awareness campaigns and coordinate efforts. Emphasizing early diagnosis, he advised anyone with fever and chills to undergo blood tests immediately and seek timely medical care. District Medical and Health Officer Dr M Suhasini, Deputy DMHO Dr K Indumathi Devi, and other health officials attended.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の制御がマラリア予防の鍵：コレクター
triage.triage_reason: ワールドマラリアデーのイベント記事であり、マラリア、デング、チクングニアなど複数のベクター媒介感染症が言及されているが、具体的な感染者数や死亡者、異常な増加の報告がなく、むしろ予防啓発活動である。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はワールドマラリアデーを機とした予防啓発イベントであり、流行警報ではない。複数のベクター媒介感染症（マラリア、デング、チクングニア）が地域に風土病として存在することは確認できるが、異常な発生状況の報告はない。感染者数、重症度、死亡者などの具体的データが記事に含まれていないため、詳細なリスク評価には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Malaysia's current malaria battle front: Zoonotic disease
article.articleSummary: Zoonotic malaria, caused by Plasmodium knowlesi, dominates Malaysia's malaria burden in 2024 with 1,927 cases and 3 deaths, despite a 33% drop in indigenous P. knowlesi cases from 2023. Malaysia, previously successful against P. falciparum and P. vivax, faces complex transmission cycles involving macaques and Anopheles mosquitoes, forest ecosystems, and wildlife interfaces that complicate surveillance and control. Sabah, Sarawak, Kelantan, and Pahang report higher concentrations, underpinning border malaria risks along porous borders with Thailand and Indonesia that sustain cross-border importation. Calls for regional cooperation, harmonised surveillance and vector control underpin the strategy to eliminate malaria by 2030. Ongoing research in Gua Musang (Kelantan) and Sabah brings together UKM, UM, Mahidol University (Thailand), the Kelantan Health Department and the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine to study transmission dynamics, vectors, and community engagement. World Malaria Day 2026 theme: Driven to End Malaria: Now We Can. Now We Must.

triage.headline_ja: マレーシアの現在のマラリア対策の最前線：人獣共通感染症
triage.triage_reason: マレーシアでのマラリア（特にP. knowlesi）の継続的な流行が確認されており、スクリーニング基準複数に該当するが、死亡数が限定的（3例）で、国際的拡大リスクの明確な証拠に欠ける。情報収集継続が必要。
triage.notes: IHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準4つ該当。マレーシアでのP. knowlesisによるマラリアは持続的であり、国境を越えた伝播リスク（タイ・インドネシアとの国境）が指摘されている。ただし死亡数が限定的（3例）であり、2023年比での症例減少（33%低下）も見られる。各国の研究機関による協調的な対応が進められている。WATCH判定：WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当かつ国際協力体制があるため、引き続き経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ini Penjelasan Dokter Anak soal Influenza yang Bisa Menyerang Paru, Jantung, dan Otak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Pediatrician's Explanation About Influenza That Can Affect the Lungs, Heart, and Brain.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A and B viruses can cause severe disease beyond the typical fever, cough, and runny nose. In Jakarta, Indonesia, pediatric expert Prof. Dr. Dr. Soedjatmiko, Sp.A (K) warns that influenza is not a mild illness. When infections are heavy, the virus can attack the lungs, causing pneumonia and breathing difficulty, and it can also impact the heart and brain. Risk is higher for infants and young children, the elderly, and people with comorbidities such as diabetes, heart disease, or blood disorders. Although not always publicized, serious influenza cases occur in hospitals, sometimes with oxygen deficiency requiring medical equipment. Diagnosis relies on confirmatory testing, including swabs. The article emphasizes vigilance that influenza can lead to severe outcomes, underscoring the need for timely evaluation in affected patients in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザが肺、心臓、脳を攻撃する可能性について小児科医が説明
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャカルタ）でのインフルエンザA型に関する医学的警告記事。重症化の可能性が指摘されているが、具体的な患者数、死亡数、異常な増加といった数値的裏付けが記事に記載されていない。医学専門家による一般的な注意喚起の性格が強く、新規発生事象というより既知の感染症の臨床上の特徴に関する説明記事である。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア（ジャカルタ）での小児科医による医学的警告であるが、具体的な発生件数、死亡数、異常な増加パターンの記載がない。インフルエンザはヒト-ヒト感染性があり流行しやすい疾患である点で WPRO基準の1項目に該当するが、この記事は新規のアウトブレイク報告ではなく既知の臨床的特徴の啓発記事である。引き続き同地域でのインフルエンザの流行情報の経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Health dept warns of malaria spread
article.articleSummary: As of 26 April 2026, Ernakulam district (Kochi), Kerala, cautions the public about the spread of malaria. Malaria is transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes and presents with fever and severe headache. Travellers who have been outside Kerala and develop symptoms should undergo a malaria blood test; testing is available at primary health centres, taluk hospitals, district hospitals, and public health laboratories. Malaria diagnosis relies on laboratory testing. Effective and complete treatment is available free of charge in all government hospitals per approved guidelines. The message emphasizes vigilance and access to free treatment to curb spread. Public health authorities urge timely reporting of feverish illness and to seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 保健部がマラリア蔓延について警告
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーララ州コーチンでマラリアの警告が発令されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露の可能性）に該当する可能性があるが、記事から重症度や新規クラスタのエビデンスが明確でなく、情報が限定的。
triage.notes: 記事はケーララ州エルナクラム地区（コーチン）での公衆衛生当局によるマラリア警告を報じている。既知の風土病であるが、公式な警告の発令と公開キャンペーンが社会的関心の高さを示している。ただし、症例数、死亡情報、新規クラスタの詳細が不明であり、IHR基準は満たさない。蚊媒介感染症の流行易しさと継続的な曝露リスクはWPRO基準に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: No Dia Mundial de Luta contra a Malária, governo de RO destaca avanços no controle da doença no estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On World Malaria Day, the Rondônia government highlights advances in malaria control in the state.
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day, Rondônia, Brazil, reports progress in malaria control through Agevisa/RO-led strategies to expand diagnosis and treatment access, strengthen epidemiological surveillance, and train health workers. A key advance is tafenoquine, a single-dose therapy that reduces relapses and interrupts transmission, reinforcing population protection. Officials credit integrated efforts among state, municipalities, and the federal government for fewer malaria cases and deaths, with emphasis on early diagnosis, timely treatment, and targeted actions in vulnerable areas. Nationally, malaria indicators have improved, and Rondônia municipalities Porto Velho, Itapuã do Oeste, Cujubim, Guajará-Mirim, and Candeias do Jamari received the Ministry of Health’s Selo de Boas Práticas Rumo à Eliminação da Malária during ExpoEpi in Brasília, recognizing impact and performance. Valdir França notes rapid testing, home-visit campaigns, educational outreach, and professional training as core components of transmission control in the state.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア根絶に向けた世界的闘争の日、ロンドニア州政府は州内のマラリア制御の進展を強調
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジル・ロンドニア州のマラリア対策の進捗を報告する肯定的なニュースであり、新たな感染症危機を示唆していない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当せず、シグナルとしての要件を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は世界マラリアデー関連の政府発表であり、マラリア対策の成功事例を報告している。新規発生状況、異常な病例増加、または国際的な懸念を示唆する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Travel warning for Brits as cases of viral disease rise five-fold
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever cases rose 5.6-fold in 2025, totaling 346 confirmed cases and 143 deaths across seven South/Central American countries and territories; since early 2026, 41 confirmed cases and 18 deaths have been reported from Bolivia, Colombia, Peru and Venezuela. Transmission is via mosquitoes in Africa and parts of Central/South America and Trinidad; risk remains high in endemic African areas and in South America, with jungle transmission near urban centers raising the threat of urban outbreaks. In 2024 most cases were in the Amazon, but spread has reached Sao Paulo State (Brazil) and Tolima Department (Colombia), with Venezuela reporting cases in new areas. Colombia has ongoing transmission since mid-2024, with 153 confirmed cases (62 deaths). Travelers should check vaccination and certificate requirements; yellow fever vaccine is recommended for travellers nine months and older to risk areas, costing about £60–£85 and not free on the NHS. Symptoms typically appear 3–6 days after a bite and include fever, flu-like symptoms, jaundice, dark urine, abdominal pain and bleeding; urgent care is advised if unwell after travel.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性疾患の症例が5倍に増加する中、イギリス人への旅行警告
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病が南米・中米で急増（2025年346例、2026年41例）し、死亡率も高い。複数国での継続的な伝播、都市部への拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある蚊媒介、国際的な旅行への影響が確認され、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外の地理的拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは南米複数国（ボリビア、コロンビア、ペルー、ベネズエラ）および南米・アフリカ全般での黄熱病の急増を報告しているが、評価対象国リストに含まれるのはBrazilのみ。記事は2025年通年で346例、2026年初頭で41例の確認と143例の死亡を報告し、サンパウロ州（ブラジル）への伝播拡大を明示している。インフルエンザは疾患リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題は黄熱病であり、インフルエンザに関する具体的な情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Why typhoid is becoming harder to treat in India
article.articleSummary: Typhoid fever, caused by Salmonella typhi and spread through contaminated food and water, remains a major public health challenge in India. The disease burden is high, and management is increasingly hampered by antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Rising multidrug-resistant (MDR) and extensively drug-resistant (XDR) Salmonella typhi strains are reducing the effectiveness of standard antibiotics. A 2023 Lancet study, Burden of typhoid fever and antimicrobial resistance in India, is cited to illustrate both the substantial burden and the AMR threat. As of 2026-04-25, typhoid is becoming harder to treat in India due to AMR, with implications for patient outcomes and the choice of therapy. The report highlights the convergence of high disease burden and evolving resistance, underscoring AMR as a critical obstacle in typhoid control.

triage.headline_ja: インドで腸チフスが治療困難になっている理由
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける腸チフスの薬剤耐性化（MDR/XDR株の増加）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示しており、IHR基準2項目（深刻性・異常性）に該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で複数該当。
triage.notes: 腸チフスの薬剤耐性化はインドで認識された公衆衛生上の重要課題であり、AMRの増加による治療選択肢の制限は国際的な感染症対策の関心事項。Lancet 2023年の疫学研究により科学的根拠が支持されている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Karnataka completes surveillance after H5N1 outbreak at Hesaraghatta poultry centre
article.articleSummary: H5N1 outbreak at the State Poultry Rearing Training Centre in Mathkuru village, Hesaraghatta, Bengaluru, Karnataka, was confirmed on April 14 by the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases, Bhopal. A 10-day intensive surveillance and containment operation has been completed as of 2026-04-26. No human infections detected so far. An infected zone 0-3 km and a 3-10 km surveillance zone were established around the farm. All birds were culled; eggs and contaminated feed disposed per biosecurity protocols. Surveillance covered 28,172 people across 22 villages within a 10-km radius. Authorities urged the public not to consume meat or eggs from sick birds and to report unusual bird deaths immediately. The outbreak remains contained with monitoring concluded.

triage.headline_ja: カルナータカ州がヘサラガッタ養鶏場のH5N1アウトブレイク後の監視を完了
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の動物における確認事例であり、IHR基準は該当しやすいが、ヒト感染がなく、アウトブレイクが既に収束・監視完了段階にあるため。情報不足の可能性も考慮し、WATCHとする。
triage.notes: H5N1は人獣共通感染症であり、ヒト感染の可能性がある。現在ヒト感染は検出されていないが、広範な監視（28,172人、22村）が実施されており、当局の対応能力は高い。アウトブレイクは既に収束段階にあり、国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし、H5N1は常に監視継続の対象であり、WATCH判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: 这种古老、危害重的传染病 现在情况如何了？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the current status of this ancient, highly dangerous infectious disease?
article.articleSummary: China marks the 19th National Malaria Day on 2026-04-26, emphasizing prevention of importation and early detection and treatment to maintain zero domestic transmission. Malaria was once a major burden in China; elimination was declared by the WHO on 2021-06-30. Globally, malaria resurged in 2024 with about 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths, 94% of cases and 95% of deaths in Africa. Domestic cases are zero, but imported malaria remains the key challenge, intensified by increased travel and warmer climates extending mosquito activity. Symptoms include cycles of cold, fever, and sweating; severe malaria can cause cerebral malaria, severe anemia, kidney failure, or shock. Prevention abroad includes avoiding bites (Africa, Southeast Asia) and protective measures; after returning, monitor for 12 months, seek care promptly with blood smear or rapid test, and complete treatment. Donors with recent travel to endemic areas or malaria recovery within 3 years should not donate.

triage.headline_ja: この古くて危険な感染症の現在の状況はどうなっているか？
triage.triage_reason: 中国のマラリア排除宣言後の輸入症例管理に関する啓発記事。国内感染はゼロだが、国際的なマラリア再興と輸入リスクについて言及されている。ただし新規のアウトブレイクや深刻な事象の報告ではなく、情報が予防啓発に限定されているため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中国の第19回全国マラリアデー（2026年4月26日）に関する啓発記事。中国は2021年6月30日にWHOからマラリア排除を宣言済み。現在は国内感染ゼロながら、輸入症例と国際的なマラリア再興（2024年に世界で約2.82億症例、61万死亡）に対する警戒が主眼。新規のアウトブレイク報告ではなく予防・検査体制の説明に重点。アフリカへの言及はマラリアの全球的負担の文脈のみで、アフリカでの新規事象報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 肠道菌群代谢物共轭亚油可抵抗沙门菌感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Conjugated linoleic acid, a metabolite of the gut microbiota, can resist Salmonella infection.
article.articleSummary: Conjugated linoleic acid (CLA), a metabolite produced by the gut microbiota, enhances host resistance to Salmonella infection by modulating immune cell metabolism. Researchers from the Shanghai Veterinary Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences, reported in Gut Microbes that CLA acts via a two-step process: restructure the gut environment by enriching beneficial bacteria such as Lactobacillus to promote an immune-activating milieu while inhibiting Salmonella colonization and preserving the intestinal barrier; and train immunity by activating receptor signaling pathways that drive metabolic reprogramming of immune cells, boosting oxidative metabolism and effector functions. The study clarifies the molecular mechanism by which microbiota-derived metabolites regulate mucosal immunity and offers a theoretical basis for nutrition-based strategies to combat Salmonella infections. Findings were funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China, Shanghai Municipal Science and Technology Innovation Program, and the Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences Innovation Project.

triage.headline_ja: 腸内菌群の代謝物である共役リノール酸がサルモネラ感染に抵抗できる

triage.notes: 記事は上海の獣医研究所による基礎研究に関する学術報道である。サルモネラ感染に関する分子メカニズムの研究成果を報告しているが、実際の感染症イベント（患者発生、アウトブレイク、拡大リスク）の報告ではない。したがって感染症危機管理のシグナルとしては該当しない。記事サマリーから実際の感染症アウトブレイクが中国で発生していることを示す情報がないため、verified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Жителям Красноярского края рассказали об опасности малярии: болезнь способна напомнить о себе спустя три года
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Residents of Krasnoyarsk Krai were warned about the danger of malaria: the disease can reappear after three years.
article.articleSummary: Malaria threat warned for Krasnoyarsk Krai. Mosquito vectors transmit malaria, with infections linked to travel to Africa, Asia, India, and South America; imported cases occur among travelers returning home. Regional Rospotrebnadzor notes symptoms often do not appear immediately; incubation is typically 8–16 days but can extend up to three years. To reduce risk, travelers should start antimalarial chemoprophylaxis seven days before departure (prescribed by a doctor), continue during travel, and take medication for one month after returning. Preventive measures include mosquito nets, fumigants, bed canopies, long-sleeved clothing, and skin repellents. If fever rises long after travel, seek medical attention promptly and inform clinicians about trips to warm countries.

triage.headline_ja: クラスノヤルスク地方の住民にマラリアの危険性について説明：この病気は3年後に再び現れる可能性がある

triage.notes: 記事はクラスノヤルスク地方での実際の発生報告ではなく、旅行者による輸入症例のリスク警告・予防啓発が主題。記事サマリーではアフリカ、アジア、インド、南米への渡航との関連が述べられており、対象国リスト中ではインドのみが該当。ロシア連邦内での流行兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah DBD dan Malaria, Rutan Rengat Lakukan Fogging Massal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Dengue Fever and Malaria, Rengat Detention Center Conducts Mass Fogging.
article.articleSummary: At Rengat Class IIB Detention Center in Riau, Indonesia, authorities conducted mass fogging to prevent dengue fever (DBD) and malaria. On 25 April 2026, the operation, in collaboration with Pekan Heran Health Center, covered offices and inmate housing blocks to suppress mosquito populations. Before spraying, all inmates (WBP) were moved out under tight supervision to ensure safety. Health teams sprayed all corners and potential breeding sites, aiming to significantly reduce mosquitoes and create a healthier resident environment. Detention center head Dedy Irawan described the action as preventive to break the mosquito life cycle, noting it is routine during weather changes. Officials also urged environmental cleanliness and removal of standing water to protect inmates and staff from DBD and malaria.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とマラリアを予防、レンガット拘置所が一斉消毒を実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのリアウ州拘置所における予防的な蚊対策実施の報告。症例報告やアウトブレイク警告ではなく、既存のリスク低減活動であり、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱およびマラリアの新規症例やアウトブレイク発生ではなく、拘置所当局が実施した日常的な予防的蚊対策（一斉消毒）の実施報告である。季節変動期における通常の予防措置として記載されており、公衆衛生上の危機事象ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Gastroenterologists Raise Concern Over Risk Of Misdiagnosis Amid Similar Symptoms At Big Update 2026 Infecon Bhopal
article.articleSummary: At Big Update 2026 InfECON in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, gastroenterology experts warned of misdiagnosis risk as infection and inflammatory symptoms overlap, stressing the need for accurate diagnostic testing and clinical acumen amid rising antibiotic resistance. The conference, organized by the Bhopal Institute of Gastroenterology and Gastrocare Multi-speciality Hospital, discussed cholangitis, Helicobacter pylori infection, liver abscesses, and Hepatitis B, with extensive case discussions, new guidelines, and treatment advances. Participants highlighted indiscriminate antibiotic use as a driver of resistant infections, potentially sparking a public health crisis. Dr. Rajesh Gupta of Hyderabad attributed current GI infection burdens to contaminated food, unsafe water, and sanitation gaps, compounded by unnecessary antibiotics. The event emphasized integrating laboratory confirmation with clinical judgment to prevent misdiagnoses and optimize management, particularly for conditions like cholangitis and hepatitis B, in the Indian context.

article.articleHeadline: 'หมอยง' เตือน 'ไวรัสตับอักเสบ เอ' ระบาดภาคตะวันออก เสี่ยงพุ่งช่วงหน้าฝน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Yong warns of Hepatitis A outbreaks in the eastern region, with a surge expected during the rainy season.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A outbreaks are warned for Thailand’s eastern region, with a projected surge during the rainy season. Professor Yong Poovorawan, a virology expert at Chulalongkorn University, cautioned on 26 April 2026 that Hepatitis A transmission is likely to rise this year. The virus is an enterovirus spread via fecal-oral routes, contaminating environments and foods or drinking water, enabling large outbreaks especially among those without immunity. Although multiple genotypes exist, Hepatitis A has a single serotype, conferring lifelong immunity after infection or vaccination. In Thailand, most people under 40 lack immunity absent vaccination; about 50% of those aged 40–50 already have immunity, and most people over 60 are immune due to prior natural infection. Recommendations include avoiding raw foods and implementing vaccination to prevent outbreaks in the eastern region during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: 医師ヨン氏が東部地域のA型肝炎流行を警告、雨季の急増が懸念される
triage.triage_reason: A型肝炎とエンテロウイルス症候群が確認され、東部地域での雨季における流行予測があるため、スクリーニング基準（異常性・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当する可能性があるが、現在の重症度や正確な患者数などの詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は警告的で専門家によるコメントであり、既に発生している流行状況というより予測警告の性質が強い。現在の患者数、死亡例、重症度の詳細が記載されていないため、情報は限定的。雨季における流行のリスク予測であり、実際の流行拡大状況の経過を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ไวรัสตับอักเสบ เอ ระบาด 'หมอยง' ห่วงคนไทยอายุต่ำกว่า 40 ไม่มีภูมิต้านทาน - The Bangkok Insight
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis A outbreak: Dr Yong worries that Thai people under 40 have no immunity
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A is causing an outbreak in the eastern region of Thailand this year, with concern that Thais under 40 lack immunity. Prof. Yong Puworawan of Chulalongkorn University explains HAV is an enterovirus transmitted fecal–orally via contaminated water and environments, leading to food- or waterborne outbreaks. Although there are several genotypes, HAV has a single serotype, giving lifelong immunity after infection or vaccination. Most people under 40 have no immunity; about half of those aged 40–50 are immune, and those over 60 often have natural immunity. Sanitation advances have reduced exposure for younger generations. The current outbreak is already visible in the summer, raising worries about more cases in the monsoon. Likely sources include migrant workers introducing the virus into factories; emphasize hygiene and vaccination for food-industry personnel. Cook shellfish thoroughly, as HAV can survive in seawater; heating above 85°C kills the virus; raw shellfish pose risk.

triage.headline_ja: A型肝炎の流行：楊医学博士がタイの40歳未満の国民に免疫がないことを懸念
triage.triage_reason: タイ東部でのA型肝炎の流行は、40歳未満の大部分が免疫を欠いており、雨季での患者増加の懸念があるため、予想外の公衆衛生上の影響を持つ。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性（経口感染）と環境への関連性から、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は東部タイでの現在進行中のA型肝炎流行を報告。免疫構造の脆弱性（40歳未満の大多数が免疫欠如）、雨季での患者増加の懸念、移民労働者による媒介、食品産業関連のリスク等から、公衆衛生学的に重要なシグナル。国内専門家（チュラロンコン大学）による警告があり、政府の関心が高い。
